### E-44: Checkpointing Durability
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L415, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L416, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L417, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L418, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L419, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L420, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L421, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L422, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L423, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L424, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L425, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L426, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L427, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L428
- **Composes with**: B-9, B-40, B-42, B-41, E-41, E-42, E-43, E-45, B-26, E-4, E-9, E-12, E-18, E-26, E-27, E-32, E-54
- **Behaviors**:
  - The durability layer adds idempotent tool boundaries, pre-effect SAGA compensation, Continue-As-New, deterministic simulation, lazy migration, compaction locking, optional postcard, reliability metrics, and error taxonomy. (`E-003/E003-E44-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; B-9/B-40/B-42/B-41 are shipped prerequisites and E-41/E-42/E-43/E-45 are parallel consumers. (`E-003/E003-E44-002`)
  - IdempotencyKey.compose deterministically builds session_id:phase_id:step_id:tool_name:call_seq and is sortable. (`E-003/E003-E44-003`)
  - Every mcp_* and Bash/Edit/Write wrapper accepts the key and checks AgentCheckpoint.tool_results before a real call. (`E-003/E003-E44-004`)
  - A same-key irreversible call replays its cached result; a same-key call with no irreversible SAGA effect may fork/re-execute. (`E-003/E003-E44-005`)
  - Cache/replay paths emit tool_idempotency_hit or tool_idempotency_replayed_irreversible. (`E-003/E003-E44-006`)
  - SSB gains compensation_actions columns session_id, phase_id, action_id, action_name, inverse_action_name, inverse_args_msgpack, written_at, executed_at, and status. (`E-003/E003-E44-007`)
  - Compensation must be durable before an irreversible side effect, never after it. (`E-003/E003-E44-008`)
  - File delete records write_back with previous bytes; git push records revert/reset to previous SHA; pod termination records respawn with previous config. (`E-003/E003-E44-009`)
  - Crash recovery scans committed compensations whose phase is incomplete and replays inverse actions in reverse order. (`E-003/E003-E44-010`)
  - SAGA emits compensation_logged, compensation_replayed, and compensation_failed. (`E-003/E003-E44-011`)
  - SessionDag ceilings are tunable as event_count_ceiling default 500 and phase_count_ceiling default 100. (`E-003/E003-E44-012`)
  - Crossing either ceiling atomically snapshots carry-over, archives old content under session_dag_archive/<old>.archive keyed by blake3, and starts a new root. (`E-003/E003-E44-013`)
  - Rollover emits session_dag_continue_as_new referencing old and new session IDs. (`E-003/E003-E44-014`)
  - agent_pool_dst swaps tokio for madsim only in tests, injects crashes at each supervise await, and checks the three-restarts-per-N-seconds Erlang limit. (`E-003/E003-E44-015`)
  - madsim is an optional dev dependency whose version must be verified with cargo search. (`E-003/E003-E44-016`)
  - checkpoint_migrator registers transforms by (from,to), reads msgpack schema_version on load, applies older transforms in order, and never performs a big-bang migration. (`E-003/E003-E44-017`)
  - Declared transform chain is 40→41, 41→42, 42→44, and 44→45, with gaps confirmed from shipped project records. (`E-003/E003-E44-018`)
  - Migration emits checkpoint_lazy_migrated with from, to, and file_path. (`E-003/E003-E44-019`)
  - PreCompact and the 85%-token trigger acquire a cross-platform CompactLock at workflow/sessions/{id}/.compact-lock before changing SESSION_HANDOFF or SSB. (`E-003/E003-E44-020`)
  - Waiting more than 100ms for the compact lock emits compact_lock_contended. (`E-003/E003-E44-021`)
  - postcard_checkpoints switches the five on-disk files only behind a feature; msgpack remains default and remains mandatory at dashboard IPC. (`E-003/E003-E44-022`)
  - checkpoint_format benchmark records msgpack/postcard size and serde latency in E-44-checkpoint-format-bench-2026-05-19.md without changing the default. (`E-003/E003-E44-023`)
  - AgentPool computes RDC, VAF, graceful_degradation_score, and meltdown_onset_point over rolling windows of 10/50/100 calls. (`E-003/E003-E44-024`)
  - agent_reliability_metrics feeds phase-end audit; detected meltdown recommends escalation or restart. (`E-003/E003-E44-025`)
  - error_taxonomy deterministically classifies transient, semantic, and spec-level ToolErrors into RecoveryDirective. (`E-003/E003-E44-026`)
  - Transient errors retry with backoff, semantic errors trigger step replan, and spec-level failures escalate the phase. (`E-003/E003-E44-027`)
  - Classification emits tool_error_classified with bucket and retry_path. (`E-003/E003-E44-028`)
  - saga_idempotency_e2e injects a crash between compensation and effect, recovers, reuses the key, and asserts no double file write, no duplicate SSB row, and unchanged SessionDag root. (`E-003/E003-E44-029`)
  - Produced functions include IdempotencyKey compose/lookup, SagaLogger log/replay, continue_as_new, migrate, CompactLock acquire, classify, compute_metrics, and ten action types. (`E-003/E003-E44-030`)
  - task_runner wraps every dispatch; AgentPool consumes DST/supervision; live_cli’s existing handoff path reaches rollover/migration. (`E-003/E003-E44-031`)
  - Stub bans forbid production unwrap, blake2/sha2, synchronous hot-path checkpoint writes, big-bang migration, post-effect compensation, random retry thread IDs, and removal from the append-only migration registry. (`E-003/E003-E44-032`)

### E-48: Web Research Orchestrator
- **Status**: shipped (plan-recorded claim; deep pass did not independently verify)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L625, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L626, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L627, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L628, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L629, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L630, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L631, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L632, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L633, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L634, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L635, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L636, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L637, DEEP-E-004.discovery.md:L638

- **Behaviors**:
  - Extend FORMULATE→SEARCH→EXTRACT→REFLECT→CONVERGE with editable planning, three-tier search, extractor fallback, cross-encoder rerank, speculative pruning, lower-stop threshold, visible contradictions, four-stage citation checks, attribution lock, recency weighting, and dashboards (L1-L2, L8-L20). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX001`)
  - B-7/B-39/B-40 are shipped, C-48 is planned, and E-46/E-17/E-19/E-13 are parallel/coordination peers (L3-L6, L12-L20). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX002`)
  - Web citations default to C-48 T2; SemanticCite-verified evidence may promote to T1-equivalent reuse, while failures emit verification evidence (L19). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX003`)
  - Before any search, FORMULATE emits `ResearchPlan{sub_questions,expected_information_gain_rank,planned_search_budget}` (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX004`)
  - Information gain ranks lower parent-token overlap higher and adds named-entity specificity (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX005`)
  - `--interactive-research-plan` allows edit/approval; it defaults off and noninteractive runs auto-approve; plan emission and user-edited approval are journaled (L45). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX006`)
  - `TieredSearchPool` dispatches deterministically Brave T1→SearXNG T2→Mojeek T3 with per-tier quotas/rate limits (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX007`)
  - Quota exhaustion disables a tier with `tier_disabled_quota_exceeded`; absent T1/T3 keys degrades to existing T2-only behavior and must emit `tiered_search_degraded_to_t2_only` (L47, L101). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX008`)
  - Results deduplicate by blake3 of normalized URL: lowercase scheme/host, sorted query parameters, and removed `utm_*` (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX009`)
  - Results carry `SourceTier::T1|T2|T3`; DuckDuckGo is explicitly forbidden as a tier (L47, L72, L100). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX010`)
  - `[web_search.tiered]` holds Brave/Mojeek keys and existing SearXNG URL (L47). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX011`)
  - `ExtractorPool` tries self-hosted Crawl4ai for 10s, then Jina Reader for 5s on timeout/JS failure (L49). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX012`)
  - Double extractor failure emits `extraction_failed_all_extractors` and drops the source (L49). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX013`)
  - After SourceQualityTable and before context packing, rerank top 50 to top 5 (L51). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX014`)
  - Default is local sidecar `/rerank`; configured Cohere v3.5 is fallback/opt-in, chunks at 4093 tokens, and max-pools per-source relevance (L51, L103). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX015`)
  - Rerank emits `cross_encoder_rerank_complete` with a rank-shift histogram (L51). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX016`)
  - Research branches become `Breadth|Depth|Speculative` and extend existing B-40 scaffolding (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX017`)
  - After every REFLECT, prune only Speculative branches when evidence-delta ratio `<0.10` and `low_gain_streak>2`; reuse existing `prune_speculative_children` and emit branch/delta/streak (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX018`)
  - Speculative allocation is `min(remaining_total_budget*0.20,parent_node_estimated_value*0.5)` at each depth (L53). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX019`)
  - Add `PreemptiveUnsolvable` below existing goal/quality thresholds when confidence `<0.20` after at least N rounds and evidence delta `<0.05` for the last three rounds (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX020`)
  - Lower threshold requires held-out unsolvable tasks; without them it defaults conservative and emits `preemptive_stop_threshold_uncalibrated` at startup (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX021`)
  - Lower-stop convergence emits `research_preemptive_stop` (L55). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX022`)
  - REFLECT compares each new claim with up to the latest 50 path evidence rows using a strict-JSON LLM classifier of `agree|disagree|orthogonal` plus reason (L57). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX023`)
  - Disagreement creates `ContradictionNode{source_a,source_b,classification_reason,surfaced_at,prune_protected:true}` (L57, L77). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX024`)
  - Contradictions are never silently chosen or pruned; reports must render both source/year/URL claims and `reconciliation: [unresolved]` (L57, L96, L102). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX025`)
  - URL HEAD liveness has a 5s timeout; 404/timeout/connection error emits `citation_dead_url` and drops the citation (L59). (`E-004/E004.E48.EX026`)

### E-54: Eval Corpus Design
- **Status**: planned (plan-recorded; not independently verified shipped)
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L473, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L474, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L475, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L476, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L477, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L478, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L479, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L480, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L481, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L482, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L483, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L484, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L485, DEEP-E-003.discovery.md:L486
- **Composes with**: D-6, D-7, D-23, D-24, D-28, D-30, E-9, E-49, E-55
- **Behaviors**:
  - E-54 replaces D-6’s 9-gram-only plan with 13-gram plus semantic filtering, sharded storage, time cutoffs, executable test triplets, evaluation-awareness probes, and family orthogonality. (`E-003/E003-E54-001`)
  - Effort is three sessions; D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24 are planned surfaces that E-54 replaces or augments, D-28/D-30 are deferred, and E-9/E-49/E-55 require dataset/metric/gate coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-002`)
  - D-6 retains time-window framing but replaces its contamination/storage/schema implementation; D-7 gains KOR checks, D-23 matched/perturbed pairs, and D-24 semantic/test/performance-delta hooks. (`E-003/E003-E54-003`)
  - Ingest normalizes task text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, and collapsing whitespace before generating 13-grams. (`E-003/E003-E54-004`)
  - corpus.ngram_threshold defaults to n=13 and k_consecutive=4; overlap beyond four consecutive grams rejects before storage. (`E-003/E003-E54-005`)
  - A second embedding pass uses configurable BGE-M3 or Nomic Embed v2, default BGE-M3. (`E-003/E003-E54-006`)
  - Cosine similarity >0.85 rejects; the threshold is tunable but defaults .85 and the semantic filter may never be disabled. (`E-003/E003-E54-007`)
  - Normalized text is blake3-hashed to cache cosine work within a session. (`E-003/E003-E54-008`)
  - Both filters run before TOML write and emit corpus_ingest_rejected_ngram or corpus_ingest_rejected_cosine with the offending task ID. (`E-003/E003-E54-009`)
  - Synthesis never bypasses the cosine pass because paraphrase can evade n-grams. (`E-003/E003-E54-010`)
  - Canonical task storage is held-out/{family}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{task-id}.toml. (`E-003/E003-E54-011`)
  - Each held-out/_index/{family}.jsonl row contains id, path, created_at, cutoffs, embedding_hash, and ngram_hash. (`E-003/E003-E54-012`)
  - Task families are code-fix, math-proof, prose-reason, planning, and knowledge-qa. (`E-003/E003-E54-013`)
  - The task TOML is written before an atomic append to the family index using append semantics. (`E-003/E003-E54-014`)
  - Daily family/date shards cap at 500 tasks per directory; the first task in a shard emits corpus_shard_created. (`E-003/E003-E54-015`)
  - Canonical Task requires id matching filename, one of five TaskFamily variants, and UTC created_at. (`E-003/E003-E54-016`)
  - cutoffs is mandatory model_id→YYYY-MM time-window metadata. (`E-003/E003-E54-017`)
  - problem and reference_solution are mandatory prompt/answer fields. (`E-003/E003-E54-018`)
  - tests is mandatory and non-empty; ExecutableTest has input, expected_output, and kind UnitTest|EndToEnd|PropertyTest. (`E-003/E003-E54-019`)
  - provenance records generator, optional prompt_id, and UTC date to support generator rotation. (`E-003/E003-E54-020`)
  - Optional FramingPair contains eval and deploy strings for D-23. (`E-003/E003-E54-021`)
  - Optional PerturbedPair contains original_true, subtly_false, and expected AgreeWithTrue|RejectFalse behavior. (`E-003/E003-E54-022`)
  - embedding_hash is blake3 of normalized text and ngram_hash is blake3 of canonical 13-gram bytes. (`E-003/E003-E54-023`)
  - Missing or empty tests cause loader rejection and corpus_schema_violation_no_tests. (`E-003/E003-E54-024`)
  - Every new task executes all tests against reference_solution in a sandbox and rejects with corpus_test_fails_on_reference if any fail. (`E-003/E003-E54-025`)
  - The tests also run against a one-line-corrupted solution; if no test fails, corpus_test_useless_passes_broken rejects the weak test set. (`E-003/E003-E54-026`)
  - If no sandbox exists, a registered, babystep-tracked sandbox stub is permitted until a follow-up, rather than silently pretending isolation. (`E-003/E003-E54-027`)
  - KOR validation trains a tiny adapter on every family-A train split and evaluates every family-B test split. (`E-003/E003-E54-028`)
  - Transfer above family-specific random baseline +10pp aborts D-7 canary build and emits kor_orthogonality_violated with the pair. (`E-003/E003-E54-029`)
  - Passing pairs can emit kor_orthogonality_passed; the ten-pair matrix is cached in held-out/_audit/kor_matrix_{date}.json with daily refresh and bounded GPU work. (`E-003/E003-E54-030`)
  - For every FramingPair, the auditor invokes identical underlying content twice under eval and deploy framings. (`E-003/E003-E54-031`)
  - Deploy framing may not contain benchmark, evaluation, or test markers. (`E-003/E003-E54-032`)
  - Absolute eval-vs-deploy score gap >10pp emits sycophancy_framing_gap_detected for human review. (`E-003/E003-E54-033`)
  - Significant matched-pair latency or token-count deviation emits sandbagging_anomaly. (`E-003/E003-E54-034`)
  - E-54 ships the matched-pair schema/harness; D-23 remains responsible for the full benchmark suite. (`E-003/E003-E54-035`)
  - Synthetic expansion requires at least three generators - local LLM, cloud LLM, human-curated import - with at least 30% from each. (`E-003/E003-E54-036`)
  - Violating generator distribution emits generator_rotation_violated. (`E-003/E003-E54-037`)
  - Every 50-task synthesis batch reruns full-corpus decontamination against the previous month’s training data. (`E-003/E003-E54-038`)
  - A >Y one-week family improvement triggers a ConStat-style current-vs-reference check and can emit perf_delta_contamination_suspected. (`E-003/E003-E54-039`)
  - If ConStat’s reference formula cannot be verified/practically computed, a two-sigma sudden-jump detector is the explicit fallback. (`E-003/E003-E54-040`)
  - knowledge-qa uses daily OKBench-style generation from last-24-hour SearXNG results rather than replaying stored TOML. (`E-003/E003-E54-041`)
  - Dynamic tasks are one-shot and not persisted, but query hash, timestamp, and MCQs are logged to held-out/_audit/knowledge-qa-{date}.jsonl. (`E-003/E003-E54-042`)
  - If SearXNG is unavailable, knowledge-qa falls back to TOML replay and emits dynamic_knowledge_qa_searxng_unavailable. (`E-003/E003-E54-043`)
  - Production traffic grading is explicit-consent opt-in, defaults OFF, and samples every Nth turn with default 1/100. (`E-003/E003-E54-044`)
  - A sampled task strips eval markers; thumbs-down plus grader verdict re-enters ingest and is stored under from-prod/{date}/{blake3-turn-hash}.toml. (`E-003/E003-E54-045`)
  - Prod-derived audit data retains content hash and timestamp only, no PII, and is purgeable through elai eval-corpus purge-prod. (`E-003/E003-E54-046`)
  - EvalCorpusPanel displays family counts, last sweep, cosine/13-gram thresholds, and KOR status. (`E-003/E003-E54-047`)
  - SycophancyMatchedPairPanel displays eval/deploy gaps and sandbagging flags. (`E-003/E003-E54-048`)
  - Tauri commands are get_eval_corpus_status, get_sycophancy_matched_pair_results, and get_kor_orthogonality_status. (`E-003/E003-E54-049`)
  - migrate_held_out idempotently converts flat tasks to shards/indexes and reruns 13-gram, cosine, and triplet validation. (`E-003/E003-E54-050`)
  - Migration failures go to held-out/_quarantine with a reason. (`E-003/E003-E54-051`)
  - E-54-decisions records n-gram repair, .85 rationale, NTFS sharding, threshold tuning, matched-pair false positives, and ConStat uncertainty. (`E-003/E003-E54-052`)
  - Produced API includes ingest_task, canonical Task/family/test/provenance/pair types, shard/index operations, test execution, cross-family transfer, matched pairs, generator verification, perf detection, daily QA, and optional traffic injection. (`E-003/E003-E54-053`)
  - Fourteen exact action types are corpus_ingest_rejected_ngram, corpus_ingest_rejected_cosine, corpus_shard_created, corpus_schema_violation_no_tests, corpus_test_fails_on_reference, corpus_test_useless_passes_broken, kor_orthogonality_violated, kor_orthogonality_passed, sycophancy_framing_gap_detected, sandbagging_anomaly, generator_rotation_violated, perf_delta_contamination_suspected, dynamic_knowledge_qa_generated, and prod_traffic_probe_injected. (`E-003/E003-E54-054`)
  - The crate consumes planned D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24, embeddings/sidecar, blake3, chrono/serde/toml, and is reached from auditor, held-out ingest, shard/index/quarantine/audit paths. (`E-003/E003-E54-055`)
  - Hard guards ban production unwrap/unregistered stubs, 9-gram-only filtering, disableable cosine, missing tests/cutoffs/pairs, weak reference tests, failed KOR, flat storage, default-on production probes, unaudited dynamic generation, non-blake3 hashes, and single-generator synthesis. (`E-003/E003-E54-056`)
  - The canonical smoke is a semantic paraphrase that passes 13-gram but scores about .92 cosine and is rejected without index growth; quarantine records both IDs/match details. (`E-003/E003-E54-057`)
  - Deterministic checks verify filters, absence of 9-gram fallback, shards/index/schema/families, dual test execution, KOR, matched pairs, rotation, perf detector, dynamic audit, default-off traffic, blake3/no-unwrap, and ten smoke/contract passes. (`E-003/E003-E54-058`)
  - Acceptance requires all data, filters, orthogonality, pair/perturbation, rotation, detection, dynamic/prod tiers, fourteen events, two panels/three commands, idempotent migration, blake3/no-unwrap, and green additive workspace integration. (`E-003/E003-E54-059`)
  - Nineteen tests/contracts cover exact/paraphrase rejection, required schema, strong tests, KOR, 15pp gap, generator failures, 30pp jump, SearXNG audit, opt-in, shards, minimum n, mandatory cosine/tests, no flat layout, deploy wording, and D-23 pairs. (`E-003/E003-E54-060`)
  - A new eval-corpus crate with ten runtime modules, migration bin, nineteen tests, two panels, decisions, README, commands, embedding endpoint, and workspace registration is created or extended. (`E-003/E003-E54-061`)
  - Open measurements tune cosine at .80/.85/.90, generator count benefit, matched-pair false positives, NTFS at 1K/5K/10K, and ConStat-vs-two-sigma. (`E-003/E003-E54-062`)
  - BGE/Nomic dependency addition needs explicit confirmation; cosine code is proposed behind a default-ON Cargo feature. (`E-003/E003-E54-063`)
  - Matched pairs double inference cost, so the default budget is ten probes per session and only D-23-tagged tasks invoke them. (`E-003/E003-E54-064`)
  - D-23/D-24 promote after consuming this crate; later patches tune thresholds/NTFS/false positives, decide ConStat, measure generator diversity, and expand dynamic QA. (`E-003/E003-E54-065`)
  - Inferred: If embeddings.py is absent, a sidecar endpoint must be created, but the exact IPC schema and model lifecycle are not specified. (`E-003/E003-E54-066`)
  - Ambiguity: cosine_filter_never_disabled is a contract, yet the dependency is feature-gated and can be removed with --no-default-features; whether such a build is allowed in production is unresolved. (`E-003/E003-E54-067`)
  - Ambiguity: New modules ban todo/unimplemented, yet missing sandbox explicitly permits a registered TODO stub; the exception is tracked but still contradicts a literal source scan unless the contract exempts registry-backed markers. (`E-003/E003-E54-068`)
  - Ambiguity: The source calls the work a replacement/canonical implementation for planned D surfaces but later calls integration additive and those surfaces unaffected; ownership of future D-6 edits needs coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-069`)
  - Conflict: Orientation events ngram13_filtered, eval_aware_flag, and per_family_shard_loaded are not in the original; exact events are the fourteen corpus_* / KOR / framing / rotation / perf / dynamic / traffic actions. (`E-003/E003-E54-070`)

### E-55: Agentic RL and Reward
- **Status**: planned
- **Anchors**: DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L320, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L321, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L322, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L323, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L324, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L325, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L326, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L327, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L328, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L329, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L330, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L331, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L332, DEEP-E-001.discovery.md:L333
- **Composes with**: D-2, D-3, D-5, D-13, D-23, D-28, E-53, B-37, E-54, E-8, E-52
- **Behaviors**:
  - **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-12h for non-weight rungs.** Extends planned D-2/D-3/D-5/D-13/D-23 and keeps D-28 deferred. Actual SFT is follow-up; weight-level DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO is hard-deferred. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-001`)
  - Ordered posture is RLAIF > GEPA > PRM+ORM > MONA > SFT at ≥200 GREEN sessions > KTO+RLVR only after unlock >> DPO never. D-5 template-arm Thompson sampling is already soft contextual RL. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-002`)
  - D-5 receives fused observations/new arms; D-2 supplies PRM; D-3/E-53 supply ORM verifier consensus; D-13/B-37 supply cloud route; D-23/E-54 supply sycophancy; E-8 may own GEPA; no existing RLAIF/GEPA/MONA/SFT pipeline is assumed. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-003`)
  - `RlaifJudge::rate_trajectory` uses `PerRoleRuntime::cloud_sonnet`, samples 1/10 via reservoir, rates five Likert dimensions plus rationale/latency, and calibrates quarterly against 20 human-graded tasks. Correlation <.6 downgrades it to advisory. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-004`)
  - GEPA takes bottom quartile from K=100 PPM-scored rollouts, asks Sonnet for refinements, retains mean-reward×semantic-diversity Pareto arms, and evicts only when the arm’s 95th-percentile reward stays below leader median after ≥30 trials. Emits evolved/evicted. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-005`)
  - `FusedReward` combines PRM steps with `OrmSignal::{BuildGreen,TestsPass,ProbeSemantic,VerifierConsensus}` at configurable default .4/.6; alternative hierarchical mode filters bottom 50% by PRM before ORM. Feeds D-5. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-006`)
  - `CompositeReward=base-format-length-sycophancy-repetition`: .1/format violation; .05 if length >2× or <.3× median; .2 matched-pair sycophancy; .05 repeated consecutive 50-token sequence. Myopic >.8 plus RLAIF step-validity <.5 emits `RewardHackingSuspected`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-007`)
  - `RolloutCollector` writes only GREEN (PASS, sycophancy-clean, no hacking flag) JSONL with prompt/trajectory/PRM/ORM/RLAIF/reward/diff/verdict. At 200 it emits `SftTrainingThresholdReached` and opens a ticket; no fine-tune occurs in E-55. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-008`)
  - Nightly canary uses 20 human-verified high-reward/low-quality cases and must flag ≥16/20; not a per-audit gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-009`)
  - D-5 Beta observation defaults to binary `composite_reward>.5`; optional Jeffreys/fractional update. New GEPA arms start Beta(1,1); every update emits `BaiArmObservationRecorded`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-010`)
  - `UnlockStatus` requires all three: ≥3 stable-arm/no-tripwire but below-target sessions; ORM coverage ≥80%; and 2×3090 or rented 24GB headroom. Only then emit `RlWeightUpdateUnlocked`+ticket; until then DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO are blocked. Registered conditional stub is `E-55.B7`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-011`)
  - Contract rejects files/modules matching DPO/PPO/GRPO/DAPO/KTO until a recorded unlock; DPO remains specially prohibited due to data shape/OOD evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-012`)

  - Decision doc records DPO rejection, SFT-first, three triggers, quarterly cadence, .4/.6 rationale and five measured TODO thresholds: RLAIF correlation, fusion ≥3pp, GEPA ≥5pp, SFT ≥5pp, and unknown BAI horizon. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-014`)
  - Wiring exports judge/evolver/fusion/composite/collector/unlock APIs, nine event names and four commands; consumes planned D surfaces, PerRoleRuntime, E-54 embeddings, E-53 verifier, blake3/serde; persists dated JSONL/index and stub registry. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-015`)
  - Negative contract: no unwrap/todo; no weight-update modules; ≥200 collection gate; 1/10 judge cap; <.6 advisory downgrade; GEPA diversity and ≥30 trials; default .4/.6; mandatory MONA; ≥80% canary; blake3; no direct Anthropic SDK. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-016`)

#### Surfaces for E-2 (Local LLM Speed Tricks)
- **PLANNED, 2 sessions/6-10h.** Extend B-14 streaming and B-37 sidecar without leaving `model.generate()` or breaking DoLa/ETC/steering. Coordinates `CommandWindow.svelte` edits with E-4. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-001`)
- Diagnosed latency has three surfaces: 50-200ms bursty SSE chunks, per-character DOM layout thrash, and no submit→TTFT cue. Targets <200ms “snappy” TTFT; explicitly rejects vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM migration, Skeleton-of-Thought, MoE swaps, and 12GB-tier EAGLE-3. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-002`)
- Existing path is B-14 `stream_chat`→Tauri event→CommandWindow/Palette plus B-37 `RuntimeAdapter`; prompt lookup is transparent to Rust. DoLa is harmful/disabled by default on 7B, while ETC/steering remain live. This plan calls its dashboard+sidecar delta net-new. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-003`)
- `SkeletonBubble.svelte` appears immediately on submit, shimmers, preallocates configurable height (240px default), and disappears on first token/`stream_complete` as specified by wiring/acceptance. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-005`)
- `CursorSentinel.svelte` is a CSS-only blinking caret visible while `streaming=true`; no JavaScript interval; removed on `stream_complete`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-006`)
- Prefix-KV reuse precomputes immutable system-prefix KV, keys it by blake3, clones/slices into a fresh HF `StaticCache`, invalidates on prompt change, and is gated by `ELAI_PREFIX_KV_REUSE=1`; default-off until three consecutive deterministic passes. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-008`)
- `StreamingTimingRecorded` payload is `{request_id,ttft_ms,mean_inter_chunk_ms,p50_inter_chunk_ms,p99_inter_chunk_ms,total_ms,tokens_emitted}` per stream end. It flows through `/notify` and renders a MonitorWindow histogram; frame-pacing default-on is blocked pending the data. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-009`)
- A configurable 200ms submit→stream-start threshold shows “elai is reading the project...” below the skeleton and removes it on first token. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-011`)
- Partial-Markdown state machine soft-commits an empty code-block frame when an opening fence arrives, tracks open/close state, and buffers incomplete markup to avoid flicker. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-012`)
- `test_prefix_kv_determinism.py` runs reuse on/off three times at greedy temperature 0 and requires token/byte-equivalent output; mismatch fails and keeps reuse off. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-013`)
- Frame-pacing A/B is randomized per session between default-off/default-on, logs a `snappy/slow` self-rating as `UxPacingVoteRecorded`, and uses N=5 sessions as the directional gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-014`)
- `E-2-decisions.md` records frame-pacing threshold (p50 chunk gap >100ms), prompt lookup starting value 10, three-pass KV gate, and explicit deferral/rejection of EAGLE-3, vLLM, Skeleton-of-Thought and MoE. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-015`)
- Produced surfaces are `FramePacer`, Skeleton/Cursor components, `StreamingTimingRecorded`, `UxPacingVoteRecorded`, prompt-lookup/prefix-KV paths and determinism test. They consume CommandWindow, `stream_chat`, SettingsWindow and are reachable from dashboard SSE and CLI REPL sidecar calls. Smoke e... (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-016`)
- Negative contract: no pacing TODO/no-pacing literals, no vLLM/SGLang imports, and no new `model.generate` call bypassing the existing LogitsProcessor chain. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-017`)
- Deterministic checks require imports/files, both sidecar env hooks and `StaticCache`, both SSB variants, passing KV byte-equivalence, and queryable p50/TTFT rows in SQLite after a 200-token stream. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-018`)

#### Surfaces for E-4 (Chat UX Critique)
- CommandWindow is the trust-forming surface; the plan groups bubble affordances, session rails, and hard model-output rules and targets confidence, sycophancy, instruction retention, re-anchoring, doom loops, evidence-backed completion, clarification, interrupt, handoff, and intervention. (`E-003/E003-E4-001`)
- ChatReflectPipeline AUDITOR emits claim wrappers; passed FILE_CHECK/SOURCE_CHECK/TEST_CHECK/WEB_CHECK maps to Verified or ReadFromSource, no grounding maps to FromTraining, and a low-confidence mcp_think status echo maps to Guessed. (`E-003/E003-E4-004`)

- Re-anchor re-injects the system prompt, first user message, and active rules, emits session_re_anchored, exposes cadence in SettingsWindow, and shows a toast. (`E-003/E003-E4-012`)
- Completion phrases including done, complete, finished, and successfully implemented require at least one file diff, audit-verdict/test row, or deterministic-check pass. (`E-003/E003-E4-016`)
- The initial ambiguity heuristic is task length under 50 characters plus missing action verb plus no target file/scope; B-38’s continuous ambiguity score replaces it when shipped. (`E-003/E003-E4-018`)
- An ambiguous task produces exactly one clarifier card with at most three yes/no questions; after one response it proceeds without another round and emits one_shot_clarifier_emitted/resolved. (`E-003/E003-E4-019`)
- Default output is action plus one-line why plus one-line risk; /verbose applies long form for the next N turns or until /terse. (`E-003/E003-E4-020`)
- agents/voice.toml gains a verbosity section; fact_type=expertise is read before TRIAGE, is per-language on a five-stage Dreyfus scale, calibrates jargon/terserness, and defaults to competent until E-5 rows exist. (`E-003/E003-E4-021`)

- B-24 and B-42 are shipped prerequisites, C-7/C-16 are planned, and the work augments those surfaces while being parallel-safe with E-11/E-12/E-13/E-15. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:4-6) (`E-002/E14-002`)

- ax_snapshot.rs defines AxNode with role/name/state, AxSnapshot, and AxSnapshotReader::from_disk; every Tier 1 invocation returns AX snapshot, screenshot, and console-log paths, and downstream rules match role/name rather than pixels. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:38-40) (`E-002/E14-006`)
- PlaywrightWebAdapter invokes Playwright 1.56+ snapshot-to-disk in a Tier-C sandbox and writes ax-snapshot.json, screenshot.png, console.log, and trace.zip with retries=2, trace_on_retry=true, animations disabled, and deterministic seed. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:42) (`E-002/E14-007`)
- Axe runs on every Tier 1 web check: serious/critical immediately fail, moderate passes Tier 1 but advises Tier 2/dashboard, and minor is logged only. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:44) (`E-002/E14-008`)
- Stagehand act/extract/observe is a Tier-C local-Node fallback only when AXTree role/name lookup fails; action sequences are cached by url_hash plus goal_hash at ~/.cache/elai/stagehand and replayed across DOM drift. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:46) (`E-002/E14-009`)
- Tier 2 must return schema-constrained JSON with pass and failures containing region/reason/confidence in [0,1]; free text raises VlmInvalidOutput and degrades to HumanReview. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:48) (`E-002/E14-010`)
- HybridDiff avoids VLM when SSIM_delta is below configurable threshold 0.02; at or above threshold it crops delta-map bounding boxes and sends only changed regions to Tier 2. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:50) (`E-002/E14-011`)
- Verdict aggregation is exhaustive: T1 fail stays Fail; T1 pass/T2 pass is Pass; T1 pass/T2 fail is HumanReview; T1 pass/T2 unavailable is Degraded; absent T1 with either T2 result is HumanReview. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:52) (`E-002/E14-013`)
- DeployPreviewWorker mirrors cosmos_worker, polls Vercel/Netlify checks every 30 seconds using provider/api_token/project_ids, may fall back to cURL retry/backoff, and starts live smoke validation on the first HTTP 200. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:54) (`E-002/E14-014`)
- Deploy-preview execution is project-opt-in with enabled=false by default and emits polling_started, ready, failed, and app_validation_complete actions. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:54) (`E-002/E14-015`)
- SaasJourneyRunner creates one isolated browser context per simulated user, captures outbound mail/webhooks through network mocks, asserts captured notifications, and loads project steps/assertions from .elai_cc/journeys/{project}.toml. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:56) (`E-002/E14-016`)
- CfDetector checks challenge HTML, Turnstile widgets, and JA4 mismatch banners, returns Skipped(ReasonExternalProtection), never bypasses, and emits cf_protection_detected. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:58) (`E-002/E14-017`)
- DeployPreviewArtifact is added to the Cosmos types; until C-16 ships, the worker runs through a standalone task-runner tick loop and is migrated into CosmosStage later. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:60) (`E-002/E14-018`)
- MediaValidationPanel adds an AX role/name tree, severity-filtered axe list, SSIM/VLM gauge, deployment badge, multi-context journey timeline, and protection-skip banner. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:62) (`E-002/E14-019`)
- Three commands expose recent AX snapshots, axe findings, and deploy status. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:62) (`E-002/E14-020`)

- Task-runner media validation, research CosmosStage, and dashboard rendering are the stated entry paths. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:78-87) (`E-002/E14-023`)

#### Surfaces for E-15 (Sandboxed Exec)
- E-15 hardens Tier-C execution with Firecracker hot snapshots, argument-filtered seccomp, explicit privilege-drop ordering, no chroot lane, allowlisted researcher networking, per-baby-step ephemerality, and the Windows AppContainer/Job/LowIL trio. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:1-3`) (`E-005/E005-E15-001`)
- It augments planned B-18/C-11, reuses B-37 `TierCSpawn` and existing sandbox policy, replaces the Phase-0/1 chroot fallback, and is parallel-safe with E-11 through E-14. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:4-5,12-20`) (`E-005/E005-E15-002`)
- The source treats the runc bind-mount CVEs, Pyodide host-bridge RCE, prompt-injection escapes, and persistent malicious package installs as the threat model; snapshot restore evicts persistence but does not prevent the first download. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:8-10,229`) (`E-005/E005-E15-003`)
- `FirecrackerHotPool` stores `HashMap<(AgentId,AgentRole),SnapshotHandle>` with `restore_budget_ms:200`; first spawn cold-boots and CoW-snapshots, later same-pair spawns restore. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,68-70,154`) (`E-005/E005-E15-004`)
- Snapshots live at `.elai_cc/sessions/{session_id}/snapshots/{agent_id}-{role}.snap`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41`) (`E-005/E005-E15-005`)
- A restore exceeding 200 ms falls back to cold boot and emits `firecracker_restore_slow`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,63,176`) (`E-005/E005-E15-006`)
- Every restore regenerates TCP-ISN seed, `/dev/random` pool, and hostname salt and emits `snapshot_uniqueness_regenerated`; ten restores must prove all three orthogonal. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,63,65,140-142,156,173`) (`E-005/E005-E15-007`)
- `IPC_BASELINE` denies `socket()` completely; `NETWORK_EXTRA` allows only address family 2/10 and socket type 1/2, expressly denying AF_UNIX, AF_NETLINK, AF_PACKET, AF_BLUETOOTH, and raw sockets. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:43,108-110,157,174`) (`E-005/E005-E15-008`)
- seccomp checks scalar arguments only; `sockaddr*` destination enforcement belongs to veth/iptables because kernel BPF cannot dereference it. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:43`) (`E-005/E005-E15-009`)
- `clone_cb` must run `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` before the full `PR_CAPBSET_DROP` loop and install seccomp last; inversion is a tested failure. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:45,112-114,158,177`) (`E-005/E005-E15-010`)
- All chroot setup is removed rather than deprecated; supported lanes become Firecracker with KVM, gVisor without KVM, and AppContainer on Windows, with a `chroot_removed` migration note. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:16,47,87,116-118,159,178`) (`E-005/E005-E15-011`)
- `GvisorBackend` invokes `runsc` with `platform=systrap` when `kvm_available()==false`, accepts an expected 10-20% syscall overhead, and emits selected backend on every launch. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:49,71,160,185`) (`E-005/E005-E15-012`)
- `ResearcherNetSetup` creates a veth pair/netns and an iptables OUTPUT allowlist for resolved/pinned curated mirror IPs and trusted DNS; everything else is `REJECT`, not `DROP`, to return fast `EHOSTUNREACH`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:51,72,144-146,161`) (`E-005/E005-E15-013`)
- Researchers have zero capabilities including `CAP_NET_RAW` and `CAP_NET_ADMIN`; allowed FQDNs and resolvers come from `[researcher.net]` and are resolved once at boot. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:51,161,175`) (`E-005/E005-E15-014`)
- Each baby step calls `spawn_from_snapshot`; the long-lived “1” control plane remains, while all four data-plane workers are newly restored, never process-reused, and emit `agent_forked_from_snapshot`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:53,81-84,162,179`) (`E-005/E005-E15-015`)
- `PyodideBridge` is a file stub while Pyodide is absent; any future import is blocked until `globalThis.require`, `process`, and Node child_process/fs/net handles are pruned before execution. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:55,73,90,163,181,227`) (`E-005/E005-E15-016`)
- The Windows fallback requires a unique per-agent AppContainer SID with zero capabilities, `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`, active-process limit one, and a Low Mandatory Label on the working directory. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:57,91,136-138,164,180`) (`E-005/E005-E15-017`)
- Snapshot GC is LRU by `max_snapshots=64` and age by 24 hours since restore, emits `snapshot_evicted`, and reports directory size to the auditor. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:59,125,165,176`) (`E-005/E005-E15-018`)
- `get_sandbox_status` gains backend, restore p50, snapshot count, uniqueness count, allowed hosts, and last-ten blocked attempts; `SandboxBackendPanel` mounts in OrchestrationDrawer. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:63,80,94,168,188,197-198`) (`E-005/E005-E15-022`)
- POSIX and PowerShell measurement scripts boot 20 sandboxes and persist cold/restore p50/p95 in `metrics/sandbox_perf.toml`; the end-to-end p50 acceptance threshold is under 100 ms. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:65,148-150,155,170,189`) (`E-005/E005-E15-024`)
- `SandboxBackend::{Firecracker,Gvisor,AppContainer}` refactors `launch_agent`, consumes `SandboxConfig`, registers Firecracker as `TierCSpawn`, and is reachable from CLI, dashboard submit, and isolation tests. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:67-84`) (`E-005/E005-E15-025`)
- New sandbox code bans TODO/unimplemented, any retained chroot or blanket socket allow, inverted ordering, unpruned Pyodide bridges, incomplete Windows Job isolation, `Box<dyn Error>`, and non-test unwraps. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:85-93,169`) (`E-005/E005-E15-026`)
- Five-step malicious-install smoke expects one backend event per spawn, five fork and uniqueness events, blocked unknown egress, distinct PIDs, clean restored state, and an LRU-bounded snapshot directory. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:95-98`) (`E-005/E005-E15-027`)
- Deterministic static checks require three new backend/network modules, argument-family tokens in allow/deny paths, privilege tokens in correct order, zero production chroot hits, snapshot helpers, six events, and four TOML tables. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:100-130`) (`E-005/E005-E15-028`)
- Seccomp tests cover both allowed families/types and denied UNIX/NETLINK/PACKET/RAW; network tests cover allow, reject, trusted DNS, and both dropped caps. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:172-175`) (`E-005/E005-E15-030`)
- The file plan creates Firecracker, gVisor, networking, conditional Pyodide, panel, and two measurement scripts; modifies sandbox dispatch/policy/task runner/SSB/config/tests/dashboard. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:183-198`) (`E-005/E005-E15-032`)
- If measured baby-step p50 exceeds 100 ms, a prebooted warm pool is deferred as a follow-up. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:221-222`) (`E-005/E005-E15-033`)
- Windows Firecracker depends on Hyper-V detection through WMI and likely degrades to AppContainer+Job; the decision must be documented. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:223`) (`E-005/E005-E15-034`)
- Netns teardown cost is unmeasured; only if it dominates 100 ms may a netns be reused within a session, while session boundaries still tear down. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:225`) (`E-005/E005-E15-036`)
- gVisor must be benchmarked on cargo/npm/pip; overhead over 300 ms triggers documentation and possible Kata consideration. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:226`) (`E-005/E005-E15-037`)
- E-11 PackageVerifier prevents suspect downloads while E-15 only evicts their state; both are explicitly complementary. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:229,234`) (`E-005/E005-E15-039`)
- Apple/container is macOS-only and deferred; managed sandboxes are catalogued but not chosen because the system is local-first. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:218-219`) (`E-005/E005-E15-041`)
- The source estimates three sessions/12 hours and contains no shipped/completed marker. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:3`) (`E-005/E005-E15-042`)
- Pool keys/path/budgets/cold fallback, uniqueness regeneration, complete socket matrix, REJECT networking/DNS/caps, control/data-plane lifecycle, conditional Pyodide, Windows trio fields, GC/config/dashboard/measurement/test and fallback details are additions: E15-004..042. (`E-005/E005-SD-E15-ADD`)
- Summary F09 leaves the Windows trio unnamed; it is AppContainer zero-cap unique SID + Job kill-on-close/process-limit-one + LowIL working directory. (E15-017) (`E-005/E005-SD-E15-C01`)
- Summary F14 names blocking a CVE proof of concept; the source's concrete gates remove chroot, test seccomp/order/ephemerality, and never names a CVE-PoC test. (E15-010..011,027..031) (`E-005/E005-SD-E15-C04`)
- Apply sandbox hardening in NO_NEW_PRIVS → CAPBSET_DROP → seccomp order. (`SUMMARY/E-15.F04`)

#### Surfaces for E-16 (VLM Image Validation)
- E-16 is explicitly a delta on shipped B-24: add AXTree YAML, anti-sycophancy prompting, swap-order evaluation, and bounded LPIPS convergence without re-authoring the existing tier architecture. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:1-3) (`E-002/E16-001`)
- B-24 and B-37 are shipped prerequisites, C-7 is planned, and E-17/C-7/C-8 are parallel-safe; D-13 is a sibling cross-family design rather than being pre-empted. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:4-6,19-26) (`E-002/E16-002`)
- Existing B-24 is described as already having pHash/SSIM/LPIPS, axe, OCR/media tooling, two VLM modes, an RCE loop, and 113 passing tests, but lacking the four new controls. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:8-17) (`E-002/E16-003`)
- The motivating failures are leading-prompt sycophancy, greater-than-ten-point pairwise position bias, missing deterministic AXTree snapshots, and unbounded/no-convergence RCE iteration. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:10-17) (`E-002/E16-004`)
- AXTreeAdapter calls page.ariaSnapshot after web rendering, stores YAML in the Tier 1 result, compares by render task ID, emits axtree_mismatch on drift, targets under 100 ms CPU-only, and is skipped for non-web adapters. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:39-41) (`E-002/E16-005`)
- neutralize_query removes leading executor claims while preserving the semantic request; contrastive_decode compares neutral and leading variants and returns agree/divergent plus divergence_score. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:43) (`E-002/E16-006`)
- Primary Tier 2 always uses neutral framing; the leading variant is confined to contrastive comparison. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:43) (`E-002/E16-007`)
- Before/after candidate comparison runs in [A,B] and [B,A] order; only agreement can pass, disagreement enters HumanReview and emits swap_order_disagreement. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:45) (`E-002/E16-008`)
- RCE converges when LPIPS(previous,current) is below 0.02, the critic reports no actionable differences, or iteration reaches the hard cap of five; the existing CPU ONNX LPIPS model is reused. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:47) (`E-002/E16-009`)
- InternVL3.5 is a second opinion when Qwen’s verdict has low log probability or sycophancy score exceeds a threshold; both must agree to pass and disagreement routes to HumanReview. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:49) (`E-002/E16-010`)
- The second opinion reuses B-37 runtime configuration and adds second_opinion_backend rather than introducing a runtime implementation. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:49) (`E-002/E16-011`)

#### Surfaces for E-18 (Tool-Use Reliability)
- The tool path is hardened with XGrammar, a Hermes envelope, SEARCH/REPLACE fences, one-shot error-aware recovery, and ToolResult spill, addressing malformed JSON, escape bugs, retry loops, edit disorientation, package hallucination, and long responses. (`E-003/E003-E18-001`)

- Future language fence collisions require guard extension; registry latency should use caching; legitimate fresh packages need explicit --allow-fresh-package with audit logging. (`E-003/E003-E18-033`)

#### Surfaces for E-19 (Reasoning Quality)
- Four danger zones are unconditional/confirmatory 7B L2, intrinsic-only L4 value, breadth/depth pruning, and same-pipeline L6 verification. Six-layer prevalence and paper measurements are rationale, not implementation results. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-002`)
- Reuses B-39 N=4 sampling, B-41 auditor, B-27 hybrid path, MistakeBook/micro-reflection and InterrogationTree; E-19 inserts a pre-L2 gate and composes local diversity with D-13 cross-family review. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-003`)
- `ConfidenceGate` computes self-certainty/logit margin from N=4 L1 candidates. Route table: score ≥0.80 skips L2+L3; `[0.40,0.80)` runs L2; `<0.40` goes directly to L3. Emits score/skip/direct-route rows. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-004`)
- L4 `AuditorVerifierScore` is deterministic pass/fail+`rule_applied` and combines with intrinsic signals at weights auditor=.6, mean_logprob=.2, cosine=.2; each node emits `L4PrmLiteScore`; D-2 later swaps in PPM. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-006`)
- L6 promotion requires agreement between fresh-RNG-seed L1 and a rotated rules.db L3 MCQ set; pass/disagree have separate SSB events. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-009`)
- Calibration corpus is 200 production traces at `.elai_cc/eval/reasoning/`; tune 0.80 by ROC Youden-J and persist `[reasoning] l2_threshold` plus `calibrated_at`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-012`)
- Wiring exports nine reasoning APIs and eleven events; consumes chat-reflect, micro-reflection, MistakeBook, InterrogationTree, auditor and taxonomy; reachable from task/role reasoning. Trivial-task smoke expects L2 skip, easy budget and calibration artifact/UI fields. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-013`)
- Done gates preserve exact thresholds/weights/branch counts/schema/routes, require D-2 upgrade documentation and prevent “always reflect” regression. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-016`)
- File lifecycle creates self-certainty/typed-CoT/TTC/PRM-lite/LToT/L6 modules, two eval files and decision doc; modifies actual `crates/reasoning/src/chat_reflect.rs`, micro-reflection, task runner, SSB and ReasoningDrawer. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-018`)
- **CONDITIONAL prior art only:** SE-Agent is per-task trajectory search, not DGM/self-mod; its reported scores are rationale and README-only 80% must not be cited. Population is discarded after each task. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-019`)
- Missing operator is segment recombination across scored branches, but importing SE-Agent’s LLM-judge reward is forbidden. It is cloud/hard-only, never local default, and waits for off-agent fitness/GAP-1 after main E-19. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-020`)
- Conditional `recombine_segments` makes ≤2 candidates from ≥2 parents, reuses PRM-lite/off-agent scoring, keeps only strict parent-beating results, emits `l4_recombination_applied`, and must beat BestOfN on ≥30 hard tasks or be dropped. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-021`)
- Risks/fallbacks: calibrate 0.80 or retire L2 if wrong→right rate stays negligible; PRM-lite is syntactic only; lateral count may fall to 1; L6 diversity config defaults on HEAVY/off FOCUSED if latency fails; NF4 accuracy remains unaddressed; difficulty heuristic may gain historical cosine. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-022`)
- Next gates: D-2 replaces PRM-lite; D-13 adds cross-family axis; D-3 aggregates scores/verdicts; retire L2 if flip rate <2%; autonomous full-task waits for ≥90% L6 diversity pass on holdout; recombination remains conditional. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-023`)

- Extend crates/orchestrator/src/chat_reflect.rs. (`SUMMARY/E-19.F08`)

#### Surfaces for E-24 (Agent Protocols / MCP)
- E-24 is a 2-3-session, 8-10-hour MCP hardening plan: external MCP only, with schema pins, description sanitization, budgets, Streamable HTTP, and a pre-call guard; full MCP internal IPC, LLM gateways, and A2A without a consumer are rejected/deferred. - `pin_or_verify` canonicalizes the full `tools/list` JSON with tool-name sorting and stable serde maps, hashes it with blake3 only, and records `pinned_hash`, `pinned_at`, and `pinned_version` at `.elai_cc/.elai/mcp/pins/{server_url}.toml`. (`E-24:39,55-57,69-70,77,92-96`) (`E-006/E006-E24-003`)
- First connect returns `PinStatus::Pinned`; later equality returns `Verified`; mismatch returns `Violation`, blocks by default with `mcp_schema_pin_violation`, and requires explicit `elai mcp pin update <server>` to repin. (`E-24:39,56-57,85-87,120-122,131,137`) (`E-006/E006-E24-004`)
- Every list response passes `sanitize_description` against five pattern families: fenced commands, role tags, instruction-override phrases, shell-command prefixes, and external URL `?data=` exfiltration; each match emits `mcp_sanitization_rule_applied {rule_id,replacement_count}`. (`E-24:41,58-59,... (`E-006/E006-E24-005`)
- `[mcp.budgets]` defaults `tools/list` to 5,000 tokens/server; token cost uses verified tiktoken-rs or chars/4, and over-budget lists drop the lowest-ranked allowlist tail first. (`E-24:43,60-61,73,80,133,146`) (`E-006/E006-E24-006`)
- Budget enforcement returns `EnforceReport{dropped,kept_tokens}`, emits `mcp_budget_enforced {dropped_tools}`, and performs no drops when E-22 lazy schemas already fit. (`E-24:43,60-61,133,197-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-007`)
- Streamable HTTP uses one POST endpoint client→server with optional SSE server→client; SSE-only remains solely as `transport:sse_legacy`, opt-in, with startup `mcp_legacy_sse_transport`. (`E-24:45,79,102-103,134,147`) (`E-006/E006-E24-008`)
- `pre_mcp_call_decision(tool,params)` sends sanitized tool/parameters to a fast local Qwen-3B sidecar and requires JSON `GuardDecision::{Allow,Deny(reason),Ask(reason)}`. (`E-24:47,62-63,68,74,105-107,135`) (`E-006/E006-E24-009`)
- Deny blocks and emits `mcp_llm_guard_blocked`; Ask pauses for dashboard confirmation; the handler must be shared with E-25 rather than duplicated. (`E-24:47,135,148,197-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-010`)

- Public CLI surfaces include `elai mcp pin <server>` and `elai mcp pin update <server>`; bridge integration points are initialize→pin, handle_list_tools→sanitize+budget, and call_tool→LLM guard. (`E-24:64,71-75,137,159`) (`E-006/E006-E24-014`)

#### Surfaces for E-35 (Structured Output 2026)
- E-35 is a 2-3-session, 10-14-hour planned substrate for E-18/E-19/E-20: XGrammar, INSTRUCTOR/GRAMMAR modes, model-aware tool parsing, SEARCH/REPLACE, CodeAct, cloud strict schemas, and grammar caching; no completion marker is present. (`E-35:1-6,243-252`) (`E-006/E006-E35-001`)
- It requires shipped B-37/B-7, precedes planned E-18, feeds E-19/E-20 and planned B-20/B-28, and must preserve the existing DoLa/ETC/steering chain. (`E-35:4-5,18-29,241,245-249`) (`E-006/E006-E35-002`)
- `XGrammarLogitsProcessor` wraps `GrammarMatcher` and Transformers `LogitsProcessor`, inserts after existing processors, and `compile_all_schemas_at_boot` precompiles an assumed 8-role ×8-block matrix. (`E-35:49,78-80,90-91,96,164`) (`E-006/E006-E35-003`)
- Grammar keys are `(role,block,blake3(schema_canonical_json))`; schema compile failure is a loud startup error, hashes are blake3 only, and synchronous per-request compilation is prohibited. (`E-35:49,63,104,107,164-165,175`) (`E-006/E006-E35-004`)
- `ToolParserVariant` resolves from `model.config.name_or_path` or `ELAI_TOOL_PARSER_VARIANT={hermes|qwen_tools}`; Qwen2.5-Coder uses `<tools>...</tools>`, non-Coder Qwen2.5-Instruct uses Hermes, and the envelope grammar follows the resolved variant. (`E-35:55,81,103,168,183,237`) (`E-006/E006-E35-007`)
- `SearchReplaceMatcher` uses `<<< ELAI_SEARCH`, `=== ELAI_REPLACE`, and `>>> ELAI_END`; `DelimiterCollisionGuard` scans those and git-conflict markers, falling to whole-file rewrite on collision. (`E-35:57,84,93,99,135-137,169,186`) (`E-006/E006-E35-008`)
- New `AgentRole::Runner` emits `CodeActAction{python_code,tool_allowlist}`, runs Python through existing subprocess/path allowlist/timeout, exposes only allowlisted tools as functions, and caps an action at 200 lines absent explicit override. (`E-35:59,85-87,94,98,105,170,187`) (`E-006/E006-E35-009`)
- CodeAct emits `codeact_action_executed {python_lines,tools_invoked,turn_saved_count}`; the report’s +20% success/−30% turns is external API-Bank grounding rather than an ELAI result. (`E-35:14,59,71,214,234`) (`E-006/E006-E35-010`)
- `CloudGroundingClient` passes Anthropic beta `structured-outputs-2025-11-13` plus schema, OpenAI `strict:true`, or Gemini `responseJsonSchema`, and emits `cloud_strict_schema_applied {provider,schema_hash}`. (`E-35:61,92,100,171,188`) (`E-006/E006-E35-011`)
- Legacy vendor `json_object` is unreachable/refused loudly through `legacy_json_object_refused`; it never serves as a syntax-only fallback. (`E-35:61,69,102,153-159,172`) (`E-006/E006-E35-012`)
- Compiled grammars persist at `.elai_cc/.elai_cc/grammar_cache/{hash}.bin`; boot cache hits skip recompilation and `grammar_cache_loaded {compiled_count,cache_hits,cache_misses,total_compile_ms}` records the result. (`E-35:63,80,96,115,158-159,165,190`) (`E-006/E006-E35-013`)
- DCCD numeric fallback is deferred/off by default behind `ELAI_DCCD_ENABLED=1` for CSQ numeric counterfactuals and auditor numeric evidence until a private eval confirms uplift. (`E-35:65,73,238,250`) (`E-006/E006-E35-014`)
- Routing to lm-format-enforcer as default is refused with `structured_engine_rejected` and falls to XGrammar; lm-format-enforcer remains only a tokenizer-edge fallback. (`E-35:67,73,102,111,173`) (`E-006/E006-E35-015`)
- Ten planned SSB variants are `XgrammarMaskApplied|InstructorModeActivated|GrammarModeActivated|CodeactActionExecuted|SearchReplaceTier1Hit|SearchReplaceCollisionFallback|CloudStrictSchemaApplied|GrammarCacheLoaded|StructuredEngineRejected|LegacyJsonObjectRefused`. (`E-35:71,88,149-151,174,189`) (`E-006/E006-E35-016`)
- `E-35-decisions.md` records engine, mode, parser, fence, and runner decisions and defers DCCD, XGrammar-2/SGLang 0.5.11, and broader CodeAct adoption. (`E-35:73,177,207,250-252`) (`E-006/E006-E35-017`)
- Reachability is boot→cache, reasoning inference→INSTRUCTOR→mask, Runner→CodeAct sandbox, Edit→SearchReplace/collision fallback, and cloud route→strict schema. (`E-35:75-100`) (`E-006/E006-E35-018`)

#### Surfaces for E-36 (Document Vision RAG)
- Text RAG remains primary for grep-able content. Vision retrieval is additive only for diagrams/scans/screens/slides; VLM captions are retrieval evidence, never authoritative grounding. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-002`)
- `elai doctor knowledge-models --vision` probes presence, tokenizer hash and size. Default `[knowledge.vision_retriever] model="colmodernvbert"`; alternate ColQwen2.5-v0.2; models live under `models_dir_path()`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-004`)
- Cosmos gains `Diagram`, `ArchImage`, `Screenshot`, `ScannedDoc` schemas. Diagram stale-checks source **or** render; the other three stale-check source-file blake3. `ParserBackend` includes Paddle/MinerU/Dolphin plus three cloud parsers. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-007`)
- `[knowledge.vision_rag] enabled=false` is a hard shipping default. Disabled ingest stores caption+hash for visually rich inputs but skips multi-vectors; enabled stores the index. `VisionRagPolicyDecision` records enabled/budget/actual storage. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-010`)
- Cloud parser fallback threshold defaults .7 and is eligible only outside `--mode local`; local refuses and logs `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`; cloud cost consumes task spend ceiling. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-011`)
- Separate 50-query gold set evaluates ColModernVBERT vs ColQwen at nDCG@5/Recall@5/MRR. At least one backend must reach nDCG@5≥.50 before any policy default-enables vision. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-012`)
- CosmosDrawer extension or `VisionRAGDrawer` shows index state, storage, parse confidence and latest verdict/reliability; Tauri exposes `get_vision_artifact_status` and `get_vision_artifact_check_recent`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-013`)
- Wiring exports chunkers/schemas/artifact types/parser enum/verdict/reliability/RRF4, doctor probe and five events: `VisionChunkEmitted`, `VisionFallbackTriggered`, `VisualArtifactCheckVerdict`, `VisionRagPolicyDecision`, `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`. Entry points are CLI, query pipeline,... (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-014`)
- Smoke verifies an auth-diagram redirect claim and requires chunk/check/RRF rows, blake3-keyed database row, nonempty pages on determinate verdicts and a four-stage query trace. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-016`)
- Done gates require staged hash/size, working Paddle confidence, ≤25KB/page pooled storage, correct stale policy, routed reliability-aware verdict, opt-in RRF participation, mode/threshold fallback, .50 corpus nDCG and blake3-only code. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-018`)
- Tests cover visual-vs-file dispatch, pooling recall within ±2 points, low/high parser confidence, LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH reliability mapping, three-run stable four-list ordering, diagram-render staleness and corpus nDCG gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-019`)
- File lifecycle creates two chunkers, verifier, optional/new drawer, eval corpus/driver, five contracts and decision doc; modifies Cosmos, pipeline, verification, runtime, SSB, doctor, Tauri and config docs. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-020`)
- Pooling citation is unverified; if absent, use measured max/mean pooling. Target budget is 25KB/page and suggested project default 500MB; emit over-budget evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-021`)
- Next: compose B-35+E-17 for text/vision retrieval; defer cloud reranking, reasoning-tier ColBERT and vision-chunk PageRank; coordinate cloud parse spend with E-39. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-024`)
- Extend crates/reasoning/src/grounding.rs. (`SUMMARY/E-36.F14`)
- Add workflow/vision_rag/. (`SUMMARY/E-36.F15`)

#### Surfaces for E-37 (Prompt Injection Defense)
- Close the unguarded data plane - web results, extracted content, uploads, tool results, images, and sandbox output - while retaining existing control-plane visibility/schema/deny-list defenses (L1-L2, L8-L10, L23-L31). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX001`)
- E-24 must land first for MCP schema pin/sanitization/transport, C-11 supplies Tier-C isolation, and B-37 supplies the classifier route; E-36/E-39/E-40 are parallel (L3-L6, L25-L31). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX002`)
- Defense must be layered: Spotlighting, per-tool description pin, off-model classifier, provenance/capability control, ingress/egress filtering, sandbox network denial, MCP-list classification, CI regression, and output classification (L12-L21, L52-L72). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX003`)
- All tool-description pins use blake3, never SHA-256/blake2/sha2, overriding the source report's transport-hash suggestion (L1-L2, L19, L56, L115). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX004`)
- First tool approval stores `blake3(tool.description_canonical)` keyed by server URL/tool name under `.elai_cc/.elai/mcp/tool_descriptions/...toml`, including `pinned_hash,pinned_at,approval_user` (L56). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX008`)
- Later description mismatch blocks by default, shows the diff, emits a pin violation, and requires explicit `elai mcp pin update <server> <tool>` re-pinning (L56, L89). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX009`)
- Per-description pinning complements rather than replaces E-24's canonical whole-list/schema pin: one catches mutation, the other tool addition/removal (L56, L100-L101). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX010`)

#### Surfaces for E-39 (Cost Token Economics)

- B-27 supplies mode/spend schema, C-5 supplies cap errors/warning default/retry cap/estimator/BYOE, C-46 may supply the classifier, B-37 hosts backends, and C-4 hosts related spend display. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:28-35) (`E-002/E39-005`)
- When task spend exceeds its cap, abort_task_on_cap_breach waits for the current paid call, records its cost, drops pending writes, returns a partial result marked aborted_by_spend_cap, and emits TaskAbortedBySpendCap with spent/cap/last_action. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:57-59) (`E-002/E39-006`)

- Cost routing combines a local [0,1] difficulty score from task trigrams, touched-symbol centrality, and reference-task cosine with remaining budget. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:67) (`E-002/E39-011`)

#### Surfaces for E-51 (Edge Inference + MLX)
- E-51 is a 2-3-session, 10-12-hour planned extension of shipped B-37/E-2/E-26: executable MLX and llama.cpp adapters, platform/artifact/UI/probe support, two spec-only future bridges, and hard-deferred NPU code; no completion marker is present. (`E-51:1-6,262-264`) (`E-006/E006-E51-001`)
- `RuntimeBackend::{Mlx,LlamaCpp}` extends the enum; `MlxAdapter` spawns vllm-mlx on Darwin arm64 and forwards `/v1/messages`, while `LlamaCppAdapter` spawns llama-server and either uses verified `/v1/messages` or a thin same-module response shim. (`E-51:43,70-73,78-81,178-180`) (`E-006/E006-E51-002`)
- Both adapters return descriptive `RuntimeAdapterError::Other`, never production unwrap, reuse permission opt-in/lifecycle helpers, and emit spawn/killed events on normal lifecycle or failure. (`E-51:43,76,82,92-93,178-181`) (`E-006/E006-E51-003`)
- `detect_mlx_capable()` returns `NotApple|AppleIntel|AppleSilicon{chip_family:M1..M5,gpu_cores}`; `detect_llamacpp_ep()` session-caches best `Vulkan|Cuda|Metal|Hip|Cpu` by parsing `--list-devices`. (`E-51:45,74-75,127-129,180,200`) (`E-006/E006-E51-004`)
- MLX refuses NotApple/AppleIntel rather than silently using CPU, and llama.cpp surfaces list-device parse failure; recoverable adapter errors return control to existing RuntimeOrchestrator fallback. (`E-51:45,84,94-96,106,180,195-197,257`) (`E-006/E006-E51-005`)
- First detection/session emits `mlx_apple_platform_detected` and `llamacpp_ep_detected`; parse failure additionally emits `llamacpp_ep_detected_parse_failed`. (`E-51:45,76,105,123-125,181,257`) (`E-006/E006-E51-006`)
- Only `--runtime mlx|llamacpp` or `ELAI_RUNTIME_BACKEND` inserts the selected backend above Sidecar; unspecified/default remains `[Sidecar,AnthropicApi,...]`, and every start emits `runtime_chain_built {resolved_chain}`. (`E-51:47,76,85,96,104-106,135-139,182,197,201`) (`E-006/E006-E51-007`)
- Supported artifact conventions are two existing HF directories, `models/mlx/{model}-mlx-{q4|q8}/`, and `models/gguf/{model}-{Q4_K_M|Q5_K_M|Q8_0}.gguf`; `_README.md` documents and pins them. (`E-51:49-54,149-153,185,198-199,216`) (`E-006/E006-E51-008`)

- `foundation_models_spec.md` is markdown only for eligible iOS18+/macOS15+ devices, 4,096 context, structured planning via `@Generable`, a Swift `/v1/messages` companion, and cloud fallback; it is not a coding replacement or live Swift implementation. (`E-51:58,99,155-159,186,217,243,255`) (`E-006/E006-E51-011`)

#### Surfaces for E-52 (LSP Integration)
- E-52 makes LSP an opt-in precision verifier, never the default retriever: one-shot diagnostics gate edits, headless SCIP refresh updates elai.map, and on-demand multilspy resolves overloaded/type-sensitive questions without an always-on language fleet. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:1-3`) (`E-005/E005-E52-001`)
- It depends on planned B-19 PostToolUse and B-29 symbol graph, coordinates with E-40's elai.map consumer, and is parallel-safe/complementary with E-51/E-53/E-54/E-55. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:4-6,12-21`) (`E-005/E005-E52-002`)
- LSP is justified for diagnostics/types while lexical+RAG remains retrieval; resident rust-analyzer/pyright/jdtls/clangd memory would exceed the sidecar envelope, and SCIP is preferred over LSIF. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:8-10`) (`E-005/E005-E52-003`)
- `DiagnosticProbe` dispatches `.rs` to `rust-analyzer diagnostics --output-format=json`, `.py` to `pyright --outputjson`, `.ts/.tsx` to `tsc --noEmit --pretty false`, and `.svelte` to machine-output `svelte-check`. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:45,68-71,125-127,192`) (`E-005/E005-E52-004`)
- Outcomes are `Pass|Diagnostics(Vec<Diagnostic>)|Timeout|ToolMissing`; `Diagnostic` holds file, line, column, severity, code, and message; severity is Error/Warning/Hint/Info. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:45,68-71,117-127,193`) (`E-005/E005-E52-005`)
- Defaults are 5-second Python, 10-second TS, and 15-second Rust timeouts; timeout never passes, while missing tools emit a soft warning and do not block. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:45,98-99,192-193,212-214`) (`E-005/E005-E52-006`)
- PostToolUse resolves touched files, groups languages, runs at most three probes in parallel, and caches for 30 seconds by blake3(file content + tool version). (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:47,80-82,129-131,194,214`) (`E-005/E005-E52-007`)
- Dispatch emits `diagnostic_probe_dispatched {languages}`, completion emits outcome/count, and any Error emits `diagnostic_probe_block`. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:47,73,109-112`) (`E-005/E005-E52-008`)
- `DiagnosticProbeEvidence {language,file_count,diagnostics,outcome}` reaches AUDITING before LLM judgment; any Error forces BLOCK and structured fixer input, while warnings/hints inform but do not auto-block. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:49,72,83,92,111-112,195`) (`E-005/E005-E52-009`)
- `scip_refresh.py` maps changed Rust files to nearest Cargo crates, runs `rust-analyzer scip` per crate, writes `.claude/tools/scip_indices/<crate>.scip`, merges incrementally into elai.map, is idempotent, logs, and may queue/background from PostToolUse. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:51,74-75,137-145,... (`E-005/E005-E52-010`)
- `codebase_mapper.py --incremental` uses `.codebase_mapper.last_sha`; `--merge-scip` preserves canonical six-column header/SCIP_DEF/SCIP_REF rows and must remain stdlib-only. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:53,75,143-145,197,218`) (`E-005/E005-E52-011`)
- If no existing vendored SCIP decoder exists, a minimal `_scip_proto_lite.py` may parse only Document/Occurrence/SymbolInformation/Range; it is conditional, not an unconditional deliverable. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:53,227,273`) (`E-005/E005-E52-012`)
- `lsp_oracle.py` exposes `POST /lsp/find_references {symbol,language,repo_root}` returning `{file,line,kind}` and `POST /lsp/goto_definition` returning a canonical location. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:55,76,147-149,198`) (`E-005/E005-E52-013`)
- multilspy servers spawn on demand, cache per language within a session, and shut down after 60 seconds idle; there is no permanent all-language daemon. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:55,73,100-102,155-157,198,202`) (`E-005/E005-E52-014`)
- Default RAM ceilings are 2GB Rust and 1GB each Python/TS; exceedance emits `lsp_server_ram_ceiling_exceeded`, kills the server, and disables further LSP for that crate/session in favor of elai.map. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:55,73,100,151-153,219,269`) (`E-005/E005-E52-015`)

#### Surfaces for E-53 (Formal Verification Codegen)
- The objective uses formal methods only where latency/assurance justify them: Critical-path Z3 in D-3 consensus, Kani in AUDITING, Verus in PR CI, Dafny IR for Critical Python, and no routine Lean proof loop. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:1-3) (`E-002/E53-001`)
- D-3 and C-52 are planned prerequisites, CSQ is claimed shipped, and E-51/E-52/E-54/E-55 are parallel-safe; E-53 additively extends D-3 and promotes a narrow subset of C-52. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:4-6,12-20) (`E-002/E53-002`)
- The justification distinguishes fast SMT/bounded/deductive checks from expensive theorem proving and emphasizes that compute-based verification resists plausible-but-wrong reasoning missed by PRMs/static analyzers. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:8-10) (`E-002/E53-003`)
- The DAFNYCOMP guard requires the specification to come from CSQ counterfactual, D-13 Adversary, or a human - not the model that authored the implementation. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:10,18) (`E-002/E53-004`)
- Z3SmtCheck extends D-3 VerificationResult as a VerifierKind and supplies one of the at-least-two consensus votes without changing existing verifier surfaces. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:14) (`E-002/E53-005`)
- C-52’s research spike remains reference material while Dafny SpecValidator becomes a narrow production path for auth/money/parser Python. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:15) (`E-002/E53-006`)
- Formal checks are gated by CSQ Critical classification to avoid overhead on ordinary edits; the named Critical classes are auth, money, crypto, parser, and untrusted input, with some task-specific subsets narrower. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:16,48-56) (`E-002/E53-007`)
- Z3, kani-verifier, Verus, Dafny, and Lean Copilot are all new dependencies and require identity/license/recency/pinned-release verification. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:20,93-97,117) (`E-002/E53-008`)
- Z3 encodes a Rust signature plus independent counterfactual postcondition to SMT-LIB2, times out after five seconds, maps Sat to BLOCK with counterexample, Unsat to a positive vote, and Unknown/Timeout to abstention. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:48-50) (`E-002/E53-009`)
- If an existing CSQ Critical enum cannot be found, CounterfactualClass Critical/NonCritical is added; D-3 file presence is likewise discovered before extension. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:50,255-256) (`E-002/E53-010`)
- Every Z3 specification carries origin and same-model origin is refused before solver execution. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:50) (`E-002/E53-011`)
- Kani outcomes are Verified, Falsified(counterexample), Timeout, and NotApplicable; falsification blocks and feeds the fixer, timeout only warns, and verified/falsified/timeout actions are emitted. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:52) (`E-002/E53-013`)
- Kani properties may come from CSQ, Adversary, or a human proof file; the AWS canonical install is version-pinned and identity-checked. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:52) (`E-002/E53-014`)
- verus_invariants encodes no-skipped FSM transitions, IPC v2 payload/header length bounds, and total KV-slot bytes not exceeding KV_CACHE_BUDGET_BYTES. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:54) (`E-002/E53-015`)
- verus-check runs in a dedicated PR job with a five-minute cap and gates COMMITTING rather than per-audit execution; violations or persistent timeout fail CI. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:54,115,299) (`E-002/E53-016`)
- Critical Python flow is independent spec, parallel implementation, thirty-second Dafny verification, then semantic SpecValidator comparison; outcomes are Verified, NotVerified, Timeout, or SpecMismatch and failure rows are emitted. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:56) (`E-002/E53-017`)
- The Sonnet SpecValidator agent receives function plus Critical classification, selects Z3/Kani/Verus/Dafny by language/property shape, consumes the independent postcondition, runs the tool, and returns only verdict plus grounding from its own context. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:58) (`E-002/E53-018`)
- SpecValidator never authors both spec and proof. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:58) (`E-002/E53-019`)
- LeanPremiseHint is optional, read-only, asynchronous, runs only after another formal BLOCK, never votes or applies changes, has a sixty-second background budget, and must not delay the BLOCK. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:60) (`E-002/E53-020`)
- A nightly PRMBench canary contains twenty human-validated deceptive diffs; with Z3/Kani enabled, every diff must yield at least one finding and longitudinal results are written to E-53-prmbench-results.md. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:62) (`E-002/E53-021`)
- SpecOrigin has CsqCounterfactual, Adversary, Human, and SameLlmAsImpl; the last is refused with spec_origin_violation_blocked. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:64) (`E-002/E53-022`)
- Contracts require no Lean VerifierKind/default/consensus path and zero formal-tool invocation for NonCritical work. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:64) (`E-002/E53-023`)

#### Surfaces for E-54 (Eval Corpus Design)
- Effort is three sessions; D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24 are planned surfaces that E-54 replaces or augments, D-28/D-30 are deferred, and E-9/E-49/E-55 require dataset/metric/gate coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-002`)
- D-6 retains time-window framing but replaces its contamination/storage/schema implementation; D-7 gains KOR checks, D-23 matched/perturbed pairs, and D-24 semantic/test/performance-delta hooks. (`E-003/E003-E54-003`)
- Daily family/date shards cap at 500 tasks per directory; the first task in a shard emits corpus_shard_created. (`E-003/E003-E54-015`)
- problem and reference_solution are mandatory prompt/answer fields. (`E-003/E003-E54-018`)
- Passing pairs can emit kor_orthogonality_passed; the ten-pair matrix is cached in held-out/_audit/kor_matrix_{date}.json with daily refresh and bounded GPU work. (`E-003/E003-E54-030`)
- E-54 ships the matched-pair schema/harness; D-23 remains responsible for the full benchmark suite. (`E-003/E003-E54-035`)
- If ConStat’s reference formula cannot be verified/practically computed, a two-sigma sudden-jump detector is the explicit fallback. (`E-003/E003-E54-040`)
- Dynamic tasks are one-shot and not persisted, but query hash, timestamp, and MCQs are logged to held-out/_audit/knowledge-qa-{date}.jsonl. (`E-003/E003-E54-042`)
- Prod-derived audit data retains content hash and timestamp only, no PII, and is purgeable through elai eval-corpus purge-prod. (`E-003/E003-E54-046`)
- SycophancyMatchedPairPanel displays eval/deploy gaps and sandbagging flags. (`E-003/E003-E54-048`)
- Tauri commands are get_eval_corpus_status, get_sycophancy_matched_pair_results, and get_kor_orthogonality_status. (`E-003/E003-E54-049`)
- migrate_held_out idempotently converts flat tasks to shards/indexes and reruns 13-gram, cosine, and triplet validation. (`E-003/E003-E54-050`)
- Produced API includes ingest_task, canonical Task/family/test/provenance/pair types, shard/index operations, test execution, cross-family transfer, matched pairs, generator verification, perf detection, daily QA, and optional traffic injection. (`E-003/E003-E54-053`)
- The crate consumes planned D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24, embeddings/sidecar, blake3, chrono/serde/toml, and is reached from auditor, held-out ingest, shard/index/quarantine/audit paths. (`E-003/E003-E54-055`)
- Hard guards ban production unwrap/unregistered stubs, 9-gram-only filtering, disableable cosine, missing tests/cutoffs/pairs, weak reference tests, failed KOR, flat storage, default-on production probes, unaudited dynamic generation, non-blake3 hashes, and single-generator synthesis. (`E-003/E003-E54-056`)
- The canonical smoke is a semantic paraphrase that passes 13-gram but scores about .92 cosine and is rejected without index growth; quarantine records both IDs/match details. (`E-003/E003-E54-057`)
- Deterministic checks verify filters, absence of 9-gram fallback, shards/index/schema/families, dual test execution, KOR, matched pairs, rotation, perf detector, dynamic audit, default-off traffic, blake3/no-unwrap, and ten smoke/contract passes. (`E-003/E003-E54-058`)
- Acceptance requires all data, filters, orthogonality, pair/perturbation, rotation, detection, dynamic/prod tiers, fourteen events, two panels/three commands, idempotent migration, blake3/no-unwrap, and green additive workspace integration. (`E-003/E003-E54-059`)
- Nineteen tests/contracts cover exact/paraphrase rejection, required schema, strong tests, KOR, 15pp gap, generator failures, 30pp jump, SearXNG audit, opt-in, shards, minimum n, mandatory cosine/tests, no flat layout, deploy wording, and D-23 pairs. (`E-003/E003-E54-060`)
- BGE/Nomic dependency addition needs explicit confirmation; cosine code is proposed behind a default-ON Cargo feature. (`E-003/E003-E54-063`)
- D-23/D-24 promote after consuming this crate; later patches tune thresholds/NTFS/false positives, decide ConStat, measure generator diversity, and expand dynamic QA. (`E-003/E003-E54-065`)
- cosine_filter_never_disabled is a contract, yet the dependency is feature-gated and can be removed with --no-default-features; whether such a build is allowed in production is unresolved. (`E-003/E003-E54-067`)

E-26 explicitly sequences its XGrammar slice after unresolved E-2; E-27 requires coordinated edit windows; E-32 places FITM after the existing processor chain.
