#### Surfaces for E-55 (Agentic RL and Reward)
- **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-12h for non-weight rungs.** Extends planned D-2/D-3/D-5/D-13/D-23 and keeps D-28 deferred. Actual SFT is follow-up; weight-level DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO is hard-deferred. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-001`)
- D-5 receives fused observations/new arms; D-2 supplies PRM; D-3/E-53 supply ORM verifier consensus; D-13/B-37 supply cloud route; D-23/E-54 supply sycophancy; E-8 may own GEPA; no existing RLAIF/GEPA/MONA/SFT pipeline is assumed. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-003`)
- `RlaifJudge::rate_trajectory` uses `PerRoleRuntime::cloud_sonnet`, samples 1/10 via reservoir, rates five Likert dimensions plus rationale/latency, and calibrates quarterly against 20 human-graded tasks. Correlation <.6 downgrades it to advisory. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-004`)
- GEPA takes bottom quartile from K=100 PPM-scored rollouts, asks Sonnet for refinements, retains mean-reward×semantic-diversity Pareto arms, and evicts only when the arm’s 95th-percentile reward stays below leader median after ≥30 trials. Emits evolved/evicted. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-005`)
- `CompositeReward=base-format-length-sycophancy-repetition`: .1/format violation; .05 if length >2× or <.3× median; .2 matched-pair sycophancy; .05 repeated consecutive 50-token sequence. Myopic >.8 plus RLAIF step-validity <.5 emits `RewardHackingSuspected`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-007`)
- `RolloutCollector` writes only GREEN (PASS, sycophancy-clean, no hacking flag) JSONL with prompt/trajectory/PRM/ORM/RLAIF/reward/diff/verdict. At 200 it emits `SftTrainingThresholdReached` and opens a ticket; no fine-tune occurs in E-55. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-008`)
- Nightly canary uses 20 human-verified high-reward/low-quality cases and must flag ≥16/20; not a per-audit gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-009`)
- D-5 Beta observation defaults to binary `composite_reward>.5`; optional Jeffreys/fractional update. New GEPA arms start Beta(1,1); every update emits `BaiArmObservationRecorded`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-010`)
- `UnlockStatus` requires all three: ≥3 stable-arm/no-tripwire but below-target sessions; ORM coverage ≥80%; and 2×3090 or rented 24GB headroom. Only then emit `RlWeightUpdateUnlocked`+ticket; until then DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO are blocked. Registered conditional stub is `E-55.B7`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-011`)
- Contract rejects files/modules matching DPO/PPO/GRPO/DAPO/KTO until a recorded unlock; DPO remains specially prohibited due to data shape/OOD evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-012`)
- Four live panels expose fusion, judge/calibration, GEPA Pareto frontier and the three deferred-RL conditions; four matching Tauri commands query them. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-013`)
- Wiring exports judge/evolver/fusion/composite/collector/unlock APIs, nine event names and four commands; consumes planned D surfaces, PerRoleRuntime, E-54 embeddings, E-53 verifier, blake3/serde; persists dated JSONL/index and stub registry. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-015`)
- Negative contract: no unwrap/todo; no weight-update modules; ≥200 collection gate; 1/10 judge cap; <.6 advisory downgrade; GEPA diversity and ≥30 trials; default .4/.6; mandatory MONA; ≥80% canary; blake3; no direct Anthropic SDK. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-016`)
- Deterministic checks cover five rating fields/sample cap, GEPA+30 trials, four ORM variants/.4-.6, four penalties/MONA, 200 threshold, three unlock fields, absent RL modules/direct SDK, blake3/no unwrap, stub entry, four panels and eight cargo smoke tests. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-018`)
- Done gates require the routing/calibration/evolution/fusion/collector/posterior/unlock/canary/UI contracts, no RL modules, blake3/no unwrap, green workspace and verified citations while keeping all planned/deferred dependencies additive. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-019`)
- Sixteen enumerated tests cover route/sample/calibration, three GEPA properties, two fusion properties, two MONA properties, two collector properties, unlock, BAI update and three contracts (module absence/canary/no direct SDK). (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-020`)
- File lifecycle creates six orchestrator modules, 17 stated test files, four panels, decision/training docs; modifies planned D surfaces, auditor, Tauri and session stub ledger. Missing D-5 may receive only a minimal integration stub. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-021`)
- Open Q5: no known BAI saturation curve; log arm stability/saturation per session to `E-55-bai-convergence-trace.jsonl`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-026`)
- Operational risks: default 100 judge calls/session then `RlaifQuotaExceeded`; quarantine GEPA arms flagged by MONA; allow per-task-family fusion overrides; E-55.1 needs new deps, 2×3090 and user confirmation. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-027`)
- Canary may initially have only five seeds (4/5 threshold); cloud model must be exact-pinned/recalibrated; lazy stub registration can block without session; every cited arXiv ID must be externally verified before execution. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-028`)
- Next ladder is evidence first: E-53→ORM, E-54→sycophancy penalty, possible E-52 probe, E-55.1 after all SFT gates, E-55.2 after fusion evidence, D-28 after BAI saturation, future KTO+RLVR/maybe DAPO, never DPO. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-029`)
- IDX:141-145; E-2:1-5 | E-2 is an augmentation of shipped B-14/B-37 and shares CommandWindow with E-4; it must coordinate that file while leaving RuntimeAdapter unchanged. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INT-001`)

- Visual grounding combines image retrieval with a runtime VLM, but reliability tier controls downstream auditor/scope-planner weight and local mode can forbid cloud parsing. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INT-009`)
- B-37 is the architecture hedge; C-15/C-27 and D-1..D-7 are compliance prerequisites. E-24 consumes MCP drift awareness; E-39/E-40 contribute adjacent cost/audit posture but are not declared function arguments. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INT-010`)

- A guarded audit likely sends a typed finding, deterministically tags MAST, routes a different-family verdict, gates COMPLETE, then journals/dashboard-reports it; exact transaction/rollback semantics are not stated. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-002`)
- A self-mod candidate likely flows MAP cell → EST/contamination/transfer/traps → Two-Gate → signed archive, but the complete ordering among tripwires is not explicitly defined. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-003`)
- Mixed PDF ingest likely parses text/tables, crops figures, conditionally indexes image multi-vectors, then fuses four retrieval lists and verifies visual claims; atomic steps are explicit but transaction/partial-failure recovery is absent. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-005`)
- Startup registration likely probes ABI before indexing and per-file health then chooses parser/raw fallback; precise initialization failure isolation is not specified. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-007`)
- Learning loop likely samples RLAIF, computes PRM/ORM+MONA, updates BAI, evolves/quarantines arms and collects only green outputs; exact ordering and atomicity across these writes is not defined. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-INF-008`)
- Frame pacing is called default-true, randomized default-on/off, and off-by-default until telemetry. Shipping precedence is not resolved. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-AMB-001`)
- Skeleton removal is variously `stream_complete` and first token; observable wording says visible until first token, so intended removal likely first token but source task sentence groups both components together. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-AMB-002`)

## System: G — Trust READ/EVIDENCE/RUNTIME surfaces (taint, RRA, blast radius, MCP re-pin, cockpit, SAFEDELTA, confidence, attestation, redaction, model-drift)

Family G owns the trust **read / evidence / runtime** layer that composes F verdicts rather than restating them: data-plane taint, reproducible-run artifacts, blast-radius FS/egress gates, MCP rug-pull re-pin, reviewer cockpit, SAFEDELTA benchmarks, claim confidence + lethal trifecta, in-toto attestation, secret redaction, and model-drift canaries.

Status rule: deep ledgers and explicit SUPERSEDED/as-built corrections beat the summary orientation pass. Higher plan numbers win **target state** when no explicit SUPERSEDED marker exists. Losing claims appear as **Superseded:** bullets with SUP/atom anchors. Deep passes did not independently re-verify product code; status labels are source assertions.

Source (read-only): `docs/thefinalglance/feature-discovery/aggregates/G-AGGREGATE.md`.

- [det] (SUMMARY/CROSS-001) The model proposes or generates; deterministic harness code, frozen checks, independent receipts, or a human disposes. Model self-report, stdout alone, same-family self-evaluation, and LLM-judge verdicts are repeatedly forbidden on load-bearing paths. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L17]
- [failure] (SUMMARY/CROSS-002) Missing, malformed, unmappable, unverified, chain-failed, or unknown evidence fails closed or degrades loudly; it never becomes a silent pass, empty success, or fabricated default score. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L18]
- (SUMMARY/CROSS-003) The append-only single-writer SSB journal is the canonical runtime store. New surfaces should derive from or extend existing rows; parallel JSON/state stores and duplicate action types are disfavored. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L19]
- (SUMMARY/CROSS-004) Every state-changing or replay-relevant action—including inserted, suppressed, edited, redirected, voice-routed, and external-response actions—must be journaled in total order and reproducible from the RRA where the lane permits it. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L20]
- [lifecycle] (SUMMARY/CROSS-005) Harness-only .claude/workflow features use JD-1 off-agent evidence (real hook/tool execution plus logs/artifacts) because they have no SSB. Their negative arm must make an unwired/dead path scream. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L21]
- [gate/surface] (SUMMARY/CROSS-006) New gates normally begin OBSERVE-ONLY; promotion waits for measured false-positive/quality evidence. Default-off features require an allowlist/wire-dark row and promotion plan; disable flags must surface their no-op. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L22]
- [cap] (SUMMARY/CROSS-007) Thresholds, knees, model capability, cost, retrieval value, and external benchmark deltas must be measured on ELAI fixtures per model/lane. Paper/vendor numbers are not production thresholds or product claims. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L23]
- [gate] (SUMMARY/CROSS-008) Frozen gate inputs/manifests, auditor re-runs, writer isolation, and generator/auditor separation prevent the judged run from rewriting its judge. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L24]
- (SUMMARY/CROSS-009) Runtime backend, model, lane, and action modality are replaceable policy choices behind shared interfaces; per-turn or per-sequence locks prevent unsafe mid-flight swaps. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L25]
- (SUMMARY/CROSS-010) Local/cloud distinctions remain explicit: local can use decoder control, KV caching, and deterministic token paths; opaque cloud/OpenAI-compatible paths use validation/repair/fallback and honest reproducibility downgrades. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L26]
- [security] (SUMMARY/CROSS-011) Security invariants recur at every ingress and sink: taint survives transformations/processes/memory, secrets and key material never enter rows, high-risk actions require authoritative gates, and config/instruction artifacts are re-admitted after change. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L27]
- (SUMMARY/CROSS-012) No-removal and no-rearchitecture discipline: ablations measure but do not prune; alternative backends are additive; existing traversal, stores, routers, gates, and dispatchers are extended rather than forked. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L28]
- [dep] (SUMMARY/CROSS-013) User consent is preserved for new dependencies, destructive/high-risk operations, grill invocation, policy-engine adoption, model/backend removal, and speculative product coupling. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L29]
- [surface] (SUMMARY/CROSS-014) Frontend pairing is mandatory when runtime state needs a user surface; otherwise the plan must explicitly justify N/A or reuse an existing panel/drawer. [10-J-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L30]

- `SUMMARY/WF-K-13`: K-13 cross-links OWASP controls into that procurement view without claiming certification. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L805)_

- `SUMMARY/WF-K-8`: K-8 classifies efficiency work as absorbed, at-risk, or durable and produces only a proposal for removal. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L810)_
- `SUMMARY/WF-K-25`: K-25 persists a dated provider-native snapshot, fails stale/malformed state with distinct exit codes, and requires refresh before execution. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L811)_
- `SUMMARY/WF-K-25-812`: K-25 remains advisory: its keyword join cannot satisfy a done gate and cannot remove work. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L812)_

- `SUMMARY/Claim truth:`: measured ELAI number plus recompute pointer, or explicit design/external/pending status; never a bare superlative or imported research number presented as ELAI's result. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L832)_
- `SUMMARY/Closed-set evidence:`: render only evidence present in the RRA/manifest; no artifact means `UNVOUCHED`, not clean. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L833)_
- `SUMMARY/Fail-closed missingness:`: missing cost capture, archival, critical atom, observer event, enforcer mapping, attestation digest, or snapshot schema cannot silently pass. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L834)_
- `SUMMARY/Deterministic authority:`: the LLM does not choose gate intensity, set must-preserve atoms, adjudicate critical-atom recall, select from self-evaluation, grade doctrine enforcement, or reconcile observer completeness. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L835)_
- `SUMMARY/Frozen judgment:`: a run cannot mutate its own gate-intensity table; rule/checker claims are grounded in the frozen gate manifest. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L836)_
- `SUMMARY/External receipts:`: reasoning traces and self-reports are UX only; execution/test/retrieval receipts decide confidence and selection. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L837)_
- `SUMMARY/Integrity is not completeness:`: I-18/J-69 hash chaining protects recorded rows, while K-21 separately demands mediation/observation and reconciliation for omissions. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L838)_
- `SUMMARY/Exact handoff fidelity:`: must-preserve atoms are exact-string/symbol obligations; paraphrase is failure. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L839)_
- `SUMMARY/Time determinism:`: volatile time comes after cache breakpoints, exact time input is journaled, wall time never decides gates/transitions/promotions, and supervisor wall-clock kill is outside replay. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L840)_
- `SUMMARY/Human governance:`: removal, model adoption/routing change, unenforced-clause compilation, and cross-seat sharing need explicit user decisions. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L841)_
- `SUMMARY/Observe-first/default-off:`: risky case reuse, observer enforcement, new workspace, and billing promotion follow observe-first or allowlisted activation as specified. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L842)_
- `SUMMARY/No duplicate substrate:`: K renderers, benches, doctrine, exports, and differentiator rows extend named F/G/H/I/J/K components rather than fork them. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L843)_
- `SUMMARY/Local-first storage:`: workspace state cannot move under an arbitrary member root or into a centralized cloud store; credit truth cannot be delegated to a provider spend store. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L844)_
- `SUMMARY/Privacy/security:`: compliance export must be redacted; payment processors remain outside ELAI/PCI scope; reused cases never enter the auditor; repository provenance is retained. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L845)_
- `SUMMARY/Honest platform/mode boundaries:`: Linux observation is not advertised on Windows; disconnected repositories get no invented edges; cloud/action-faithful replay is not mislabeled token-faithful; cassettes prove an old captured world. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L846)_
- `SUMMARY/Cost safety:`: billing requests are reserved and capped, settlements equal actual metering, and “unlimited” is forbidden. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L847)_
- `SUMMARY/Advisory-cache boundary:`: provider overlap detection can prompt a refresh/proposal but can never discharge objective verification. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L848)_
- `SUMMARY/OWASP:`: WI-1 transformation-surviving taint binding, WI-2 cross-process taint, WI-3 E-37 perimeter completion, WI-6 config-ingress admission. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L882)_
- `SUMMARY/Time:`: T-1 timestamp slot, T-2 agent time, T-3 resume header, T-4 async-tool model loop, T-5 watchdog promotion. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L883)_
- `SUMMARY/GRC-v3:`: J-83..J-86 technical reasoning-engine track. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L884)_
- `SUMMARY/Context activation:`: IMP-1..IMP-8 as enumerated under K-17. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L885)_
- `SUMMARY/Verified Case Graph:`: proof-minted typed nodes, deterministic edges, MEMORY/CASE canvas altitude, gated reuse, episodic-to-skill-to-rule ladder. _(anchor: 11-K-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L886)_

### User-facing surfaces (K)

Every window, panel, drawer, command, CLI verb, flag, status display, or notification named by a SURFACE-tagged atom. One line each with atom ID. Deduplicated by atom ID.

#### Surfaces — K-0
- `K-001/K0-E007`: `[E/CAP]` K-T2 WEDGE + DISTRIBUTION (A-4, K-3, A-5): A-4 is portable `.rra`/`elai wrap`; K-3 renders evidence into GitHub check-runs + PR comments; A-5 is review-time study. Delta: KD-2. _(anchor: K-0:L76-L82)_
- `K-001/K0-E009`: `[E/CAP]` K-T4 BUYER-SIDE EVIDENCE (K-6, K-7): K-6 builds `elai export compliance`; K-7 is AppSec/insurance positioning brief (pure prose). No org/SSO build. _(anchor: K-0:L92-L96)_
- `K-001/K0-E011`: `[E/CAP]` K-T6 SEQUENCING / CUT (K-10 doctrine in index): priority order, no-new-letters, activation-over-authoring, canvas demotion, kill-switches. Delta: KD-5. _(anchor: K-0:L106-L110)_
- `K-001/K0-E014`: `[E/CFG]` KD-1 NUMBER-BEFORE-CLAIM: no externally-visible claim ships without a measured journal-recomputable ELAI number OR explicit `[EXTERNAL]`/`[DESIGN-RATIONALE]` tag. Enforced by K-1 lint; binds K-1 and K-7. _(anchor: K-0:L140-L144)_
- `K-001/K0-E015`: `[E/CFG]` KD-2 MEET-THE-BUYER-IN-THE-PR: every trust signal ships a PR/CI rendering or justified W-6 absence; dashboard is deep view never only view. Binds K-3. _(anchor: K-0:L145-L148)_

- `K-001/K0-E018`: `[E/CFG]` KD-5 WINDOW-CLOCK: wedge artifacts (A-4 `.rra`, K-3 PR emitter, K-6 compliance export) are time-boxed first-mover deliverables; a slipped quarter escalates to the user. Binds A-4, K-3, K-6. _(anchor: K-0:L158-L161)_

- `SUMMARY/ES-001`: [E] **Claim trust loop [E].** Any backend output is structurally converted to typed claims; round-trip, oscillation, semantic-entropy, counterfactual, and demarcation evidence feed ClaimRisk; risk selectively buys more evidence; a policy gate then allows, caveats, verifies, blocks, or abstains. Contradicted beliefs are quarantined, while proven resolutions may compound into verified cases. (L:6-79, L:240-259) _(anchor: 12-L:L22)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-002`: [E] **Generated-output quality loop [E].** Plan-time responsibility limits, generation-time critique/retry, write-time deterministic checks, and audit-time frozen authority enforce maintainability for every model. Rules begin in shadow and earn blocking authority from measured error rates. (L:83-88) _(anchor: 12-L:L23)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-003`: [E] **Familiar user surface on the same trust engine [E].** Skills, typed rules/hooks, a one-shot builder, artifact execution, MCP access, and receipt verification expose existing machinery without bypassing admission, quality, or autonomy gates. (L:90-112) _(anchor: 12-L:L24)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-004`: [E] **Immutable context substrate [E].** An append-only transcript is projected through a pure fold into a provider view; a named freeze-epoch state machine controls prefix recomputation; losslessness, time travel, recovery, and ambient recall become projection behavior rather than raw-history mutation. (L:117-204) _(anchor: 12-L:L25)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-005`: [E] **Measured model orchestration [E].** Real commits supply contamination-resistant eval tasks; ELAI and vendor CLI arms run under one reproducible envelope; model capability and role deterministically select verification intensity, with unknown models receiving the strongest checks. (L:206-226) _(anchor: 12-L:L26)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-006`: [E] **Exploratory reasoning loop [E].** Generators attach executable falsifiers to conjectures, exploration returns rival explanations rather than one collapsed answer, an embedding-free orbit detector rotates stance, and a lane-isolated conjecture store preserves unresolved ideas without contaminating proven-only code work. (L:228-262) _(anchor: 12-L:L27)_
- `SUMMARY/ES-007`: [E] **Planning/runtime boundary [E].** The separate improvement-conjecture archive has no FDL controller, ProbeUtility scheduler, multi-cycle operator allocator, or bridge into L-23/L-24. Q-10 only proposes a future one-way SOURCE_ONLY research packet under independent target-side verification. (O:393-408) _(anchor: 12-L:L28)_
- `SUMMARY/WF-001`: [E] (12-L:L530): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] A backend emits an answer/plan/patch/explanation. L-1 structurally extracts typed claims, retains unresolved references, and adds taint. (L:11-16) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-002`: [E] (12-L:L531): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] L-3 establishes P1 by re-grounding claims; J-85 supplies P2; L-4 establishes P3 from meaning clusters and a cross-family subset. L-5 supplies stronger interventional evidence for causal/behavior claims, and L-22 adds the falsifier/demarcation signal. (L:18-44, L:240-245) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-003`: [E] (12-L:L532): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] L-2 fuses independent evidence. Cheap signals gate expensive checks; one signal cannot exceed Medium; two distinct signals may reach High/Critical. (L:18-23) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-004`: [E] (12-L:L533): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] L-6 spends targeted retrieval/test/trace/escalation effort only on High/Critical claims, then loops back to L-2. (L:46-51) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-005`: [E] (12-L:L534): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] L-7 maps the final tier to allow, caveat/citation, forced verification, block, or abstain and journals the gate. (L:53-58) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-006`: [E] (12-L:L535): [Claim extraction, evidence, effort, and action] L-8 removes later-refuted assumptions from live working belief without erasing evidence. A grounded closure may mint J-96 verified memory; unresolved exploratory conjectures instead remain in the separate L-24 store. (L:48, L:60-65, L:254-259) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-007`: [E] (12-L:L539): [Generated code from idea to verified artifact] L-14 takes an idea through PIPELINE FACTORY and E-12. (L:104-108) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-008`: [E] (12-L:L540): [Generated code from idea to verified artifact] L-11 applies plan-time, generation-time, write-time, and audit-time quality seams. Weak lanes can receive stronger L-21 retry/check/reviewer settings. (L:83-88, L:221-226) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-009`: [E] (12-L:L541): [Generated code from idea to verified artifact] Failed quality reports findings and cannot become DONE; success is wrapped in an RRA receipt and may run under Tier-C or through MCP. (L:104-109) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-010`: [E] (12-L:L542): [Generated code from idea to verified artifact] The same user-created skills and rules enter through L-12/L-13 admission and safety gates; none can bypass immutable checks. (L:90-102) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-011`: [E] (12-L:L546): [Immutable context projection and recall] L-16 appends all history to SessionDag/CAS and derives each model view through pure fold. (L:133-150) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-012`: [E] (12-L:L547): [Immutable context projection and recall] L-17 reuses the frozen prefix unless one of seven named causes triggers a journaled epoch recompute. Tail growth alone does not move the prefix. (L:152-164) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-013`: [E] (12-L:L548): [Immutable context projection and recall] L-18 verifies critical atoms in the derived view, widening the budget on failure, and implements undo/redo/branch/recovery as projection at another index or budget. (L:166-178) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-014`: [E] (12-L:L549): [Immutable context projection and recall] L-19 appends recall cards to the tail under pressure-sensitive budgets and expires/refolds them by TTL. (L:180-193) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-015`: [E] (12-L:L553): [Evaluation and claims about value] L-20 mines real commits into hashed, base-SHA-bound tasks, then runs ELAI and competitor CLIs under an identical envelope. (L:214-219) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-016`: [E] (12-L:L554): [Evaluation and claims about value] L-21 varies verification effort by model capability/role while L-20/K-15 measures verified outcomes and tokens per correct. (L:221-226) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-017`: [E] (12-L:L555): [Evaluation and claims about value] L-10 independently ablates the hallucination gate. L-24 extends its explore arm with a grounding/retrieval novelty matrix. (L:74-79, L:256) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-018`: [E] (12-L:L556): [Evaluation and claims about value] Public comparative/value claims remain absent until the appropriate ELAI-measured paired deltas exist. No paper metric, live-cost estimate, or leaderboard language may substitute. (L:76, L:106, L:216, L:219) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-019`: [E] (12-L:L560): [Exploratory reasoning and isolated conjecture memory] L-22 elicits candidate conjectures and their executable falsifiers in one grammar-constrained generation call. (L:240-245) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-020`: [E] (12-L:L561): [Exploratory reasoning and isolated conjecture memory] L-23 iterates rival conjectures, gate-side refutation memory, stance rotation, orbit detection, turnover, and cross-family survivor judgment. (L:247-252) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-021`: [E] (12-L:L562): [Exploratory reasoning and isolated conjecture memory] L-24 stores unresolved/refuted/suspended conjectures with computed lifecycle, missing tests, provenance, and evaluator edges. (L:254-259) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/WF-022`: [E] (12-L:L563): [Exploratory reasoning and isolated conjecture memory] Only the explore lane may retrieve unproven conjectures. Verified Case Graph remains proven-only, and refuted content influences the gate rather than the generation prompt. (L:256-257) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/INV-001`: [E] label=`HG-1 causal means interventional` (12-L:L567): HG-1 causal means interventional. Static, temporal, import-edge, or rubric evidence cannot set causal_supported; only an executable perturb-and-observe pass can. (L:41-44, L:245) _(anchor: )_

- `SUMMARY/INV-004`: [E] label=`HG-4 abstain or verify` (12-L:L570): HG-4 abstain or verify. Missing/unverifiable High evidence never silently passes; unchecked math is abstained. (L:55-58, L:69-72) _(anchor: )_
- `SUMMARY/INV-005`: [E] label=`HG-5 demarcation` (12-L:L571): HG-5 demarcation. A Causal/Behavior claim with no falsifier has a High floor, and a hypothesis cannot converge without one. (L:242-245) _(anchor: )_

- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH01) [IX] title=`Define research work.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L577): The user supplies `[[research.topics]]` records with `id`, closed `kind`, `sources[]`, `cadence`, `confidence_threshold`, and `sink` (`O1:L9-L10`). O-1 swaps only this source into Cosmos; the worker loop, stage, briefing compiler, and hourly task-runner seam remain the pre-existing execution substrate (`O0:L106-L109`; `O1:L7,L13-L16,L27-L30`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH02) [IX] title=`Fetch and contain untrusted bytes.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L578): A live Cosmos tick fetches topic sources. Before prompt use, bytes receive G-1 untrusted provenance; the research role is narrowed by F-3; external bytes are recorded in a run-ID-keyed G-2 cassette (`O1:L10,L31-L36`). Classification uses an untrusted preamble, an item fence, a per-kind schema, frozen injection fixtures, closed class output, and `f32` confidence (`O1:L10,L31-L33,L48-L52`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH03) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Classify, deduplicate, and produce.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L579): The TEIKOKU-derived workflow is fetch → enum classification → duplicate precheck against a rejected ledger → file → layered digest →, at full scope, guarded living-page upsert (`O1:L10`). Tier 1 covers `steal-scan` and `monitor`; `leaderboard`, `discovery`, and living leaderboard pages wait for Tier 2/O-3 (`O1:L19-L21`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH04) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Represent scheduled execution as data.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L580): O-2 persists strict TaskSpec rows in SQLite. Each row combines a closed trigger, ordered closed stages, and a closed sink (`O2:L9-L10,L27-L30,L49-L53`). Tier 1 brings Cron/Manual, `Fetch/Classify/Gate/Digest`, fire rows, and DashboardInbox; event triggering, orchestrator stage kinds, and missed-run hookup are deferred (`O2:L19-L21`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH05) [IX] title=`Fire through the existing authority.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L581): Supervisor-plane time makes a due decision outside replay; the existing task_runner interval dispatches the pipeline; a last-fired watermark makes a due tick idempotent; the run receives recorded time as an input (`O2:L10,L31-L33,L46-L47`). A fire writes `task_spec_fired {spec_id, trigger_cause, stage_path}` (`O2:L31-L33,L65-L70`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH06) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Surface only useful scheduled output.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L582): Result-bearing output creates an existing intervention card. Nothing-to-report output auto-archives, leaving only the SSB receipt; the predicate is based on pipeline result count (`O2:L34-L36,L65-L68`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH07) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Write selected research to the owner vault.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L583): O-3’s production seam is O-2’s `FileToBrain` stage calling a guarded writer (or interim `elai brain write`) (`O3:L57-L70`). The writer resolves a configured vault root, validates ownership at a single chokepoint, creates/appends only in ELAI-owned space, and upserts only machine-owned rankings/queue/index pages (`O3:L18-L35`). It records `vault_write {namespace,page,mode}` or `claim_violation` (`O3:L65-L68`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH08) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Keep the two memory grains separate.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L584): The mounted deterministic Markdown vault is the human/owner grain; E-5 `memory_facts` remains the prompt-feeding machine grain. There is no conversion or dual-write, and ELAI adapts to existing vault bytes (`O3:L7,L10-L11,L37-L46,L53-L64`). Prompt-bound personal content is barred pending the Tier-2 D-5 read wiring (`O3:L18-L20,L80-L81`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH09) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Project, inspect, and eventually edit visually.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L585): O-4 lists TaskSpecs through Tauri and renders a node-per-stage graph in Svelte. Provenance-labelled edges, J-60 last-run chrome, and missing-consumer disconnection make execution receipts and wire-dark state visible (`O4:L19-L33,L49-L71`). Tier 1 is read-only; Tier 2 writes node edits back to TaskSpec rows and adds provenance drill-down (`O4:L19-L21`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH10) [IX/SURFACE] title=`Run-now shares the same backend.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L586): The canvas calls O-2’s dispatcher, which emits the same `task_spec_fired` receipt through the normal FSM. No client-side scheduler, stage runner, spec store, or separate execution event is allowed (`O4:L34-L39,L46-L47,L68-L73`).
- [interaction] (O-001/IX-PATH11) [IX] title=`Replay and observe.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L587): Network-dependent research replays byte-identically from G-2 with network detached; wall-clock observation itself remains outside replay (`O1:L34-L36`; `O2:L10,L46-L47`). O-1 classify rows, O-2 fire rows, O-3 write/refusal rows, and J-60’s fold of run state form the observable receipt chain (`O0:L80-L85`; `O1:L64-L75`; `O2:L65-L76`; `O3:L65-L76`; `O4:L31-L35,L68-L82`).

- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC001) [Δ] title=`Digest patches are per-unit, not literally identical across every unit.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L683): O0 says `A1..A5` feed per-unit `stub_ban`/`REDTEAM` (`O0:L4-L7,L55-L56`). The detail plans specialize them: O-1 applies A1/A3, O-2 A2/A3, O-3 A4, and O-4 A3. The summary-ledger claim that every unit enforces the same A1, A3, and A4 set is broader than the originals.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC002) [Δ] title=`The engagement falsifier is not present in these five originals.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L684): The summary ledger’s digest-open, `For-You` click, `N`-day zero-engagement, and honest topic-decay requirements are not stated in O0 or O1–O4. O1 does state an existing artifact lifecycle that decays to `DECAYED` (`O1:L7`), but it does not connect that state to opens/clicks or an `N`-day threshold. Those engagement requirements remain summary-only in this source scope.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC003) [Δ] title=`O-4 editing is not Tier 1.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L685): The original makes Tier 1 read-only inspection and explicitly defers TaskSpec write-back plus provenance drill-down to Tier 2 (`O4:L19-L21`). Any summary reading of node editing as an immediate ship-now feature needs this tier qualifier.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC004) [Δ] title=`O-2 full vocabulary is larger than its Tier-1 runtime.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L686): The schema names eight stages and four sinks, but Tier 1 explicitly names only Fetch/Classify/Gate/Digest and DashboardInbox; SsbEvent, SpawnResearchTree, RunPlanUnit, and missed-run wiring are Tier 2 (`O2:L9-L10,L19-L21`). Schema availability must not be confused with production wiring.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC005) [Δ] title=`O-1 full topic enum is larger than Tier 1.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L687): Four kinds are schema-valid, but only `steal-scan` and `monitor` ship now; `leaderboard`, `discovery`, and living-page upserts are deferred (`O1:L19-L21`).
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC006) [Δ] title=`Exactly-once is scoped to a due tick.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L688): The original’s concrete mechanism is a last-fired watermark and the acceptance phrase “exactly once per due tick” (`O2:L31-L33,L65-L68`); it does not claim global exactly-once under crash, multi-process, or distributed scheduling.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC007) [Δ] title=`Privacy is a staged safety barrier.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L689): Personal-to-project/cloud flow is a hard exclusion/stub ban, but the actual D-5 read-path wiring is Tier 2 and must land before personal topics become mountable into project context (`O3:L10-L11,L18-L20,L60-L64,L80-L81`).
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC008) [Δ] title=`“Dark/absent” is not the exact status vocabulary of the originals.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L690): All four details say `PLANNED`; O0 defines the formal statuses. The originals identify new versus reused mechanisms but do not independently inventory current code to prove each component dark (`O0:L42-L45`; `O1:L3`; `O2:L3`; `O3:L3`; `O4:L3`).
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC009) [Δ] title=`The trust-spine boundary is more precise than a blanket byte claim.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L691): O1 says G-1 wraps fetched bytes, F-3 applies to the research role, and G-2 records external bytes; integration names fetch/classify/sink seams (`O1:L10,L23-L24,L31-L36`). Metadata, redirect, attachment, and cache coverage remain unspecified.
- [summary-delta] (O-001/SD-MC010) [Δ] title=`No new O-4 event is planned.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L692): O0 explicitly says O-4 reuses O-2’s fire row, while O-1/O-2/O-3 add schema action types (`O0:L80-L85`).

### User-facing surfaces (O)

Windows, panels, drawers, commands, CLI verbs, flags, status displays, notifications, published commercial/docs surfaces, and other SURFACE-tagged atoms. One line per atom with ID.

#### Surfaces for O-0 (O-Plan Index / track-wide contract)
- O is a product-surface letter that ships a new user-facing feature, unlike N’s invent-nothing interlacing role. (`O-001/O0-E008`) [O0:L11-L13 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L45]
- The new surface is the combination of a research daemon, typed scheduler, mounted brain vault, and canvas workflow mode. (`O-001/O0-E009`) [O0:L12-L13 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L46]
- Named composed subsystems are `B-42` Cosmos, `C-9` task_runner, `3F` rules-engine, `E-5` memory, `D-5` privacy, `G-1` taint, `F-3` tool-filter, `G-2` VCR, and `H-12/J-31/J-60` canvas. (`O-001/O0-E011`) [O0:L13-L15 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L48]
- Genuinely new mechanisms are a closed `TaskSpec` vocabulary, vault namespace claims, canvas `WORKFLOW` mode, and Cosmos manifest generalization. (`O-001/O0-E012`) [O0:L15-L16 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L49]
- O-1 swaps Cosmos’s topic source for a user-editable typed topic set. (`O-001/O0-E021`) [O0:L33-L34 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L58]
- O-2 journals fires and supplies a dashboard intervention-card inbox. (`O-001/O0-E026`) [O0:L35-L36 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L63]
- O-3 mounts, rather than converts, a portable Markdown brain vault. (`O-001/O0-E028`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L65]
- O-3 adds a namespace-claims contract so ELAI and TEIKOKU can share one vault. (`O-001/O0-E029`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L66]
- `memory_facts` remains the machine-grain store while the vault becomes the user-grain surface. (`O-001/O0-E030`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L67]
- O-4 adds canvas `WORKFLOW` as an editor and monitor over TaskSpecs. (`O-001/O0-E031`) [O0:L39-L40 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L68]
- O-4 dispatches through the `J-31` FSM and must never introduce a canvas runtime. (`O-001/O0-E033`) [O0:L39-L40 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L70]
- Execution requires re-reading the live baseline and adding a dashboard done-item. (`O-001/O0-E047`) [O0:L52 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L84]
- O-4 is effort `M`, Wave `3`, with lever `canvas-as-spec-editor`. (`O-001/O0-E068`) [O0:L76-L77 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L105]

- title=`Classify, deduplicate, and produce.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L579): The TEIKOKU-derived workflow is fetch → enum classification → duplicate precheck against a rejected ledger → file → layered digest →, at full scope, guarded living-page upsert (`O1:L10`). Tier 1 covers `steal-scan` and `monitor`; `leaderboard`, `discovery`, and living leaderboard pages wait for Tier 2/O-3 (`O1:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH03`)
- title=`Represent scheduled execution as data.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L580): O-2 persists strict TaskSpec rows in SQLite. Each row combines a closed trigger, ordered closed stages, and a closed sink (`O2:L9-L10,L27-L30,L49-L53`). Tier 1 brings Cron/Manual, `Fetch/Classify/Gate/Digest`, fire rows, and DashboardInbox; event triggering, orchestrator stage kinds, and missed-run hookup are deferred (`O2:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH04`)
- title=`Surface only useful scheduled output.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L582): Result-bearing output creates an existing intervention card. Nothing-to-report output auto-archives, leaving only the SSB receipt; the predicate is based on pipeline result count (`O2:L34-L36,L65-L68`). (`O-001/IX-PATH06`)
- title=`Write selected research to the owner vault.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L583): O-3’s production seam is O-2’s `FileToBrain` stage calling a guarded writer (or interim `elai brain write`) (`O3:L57-L70`). The writer resolves a configured vault root, validates ownership at a single chokepoint, creates/appends only in ELAI-owned space, and upserts only machine-owned rankings/queue/index pages (`O3:L18-L35`). It records `vault_write {namespace,page,mode}` or `claim_violation` (`O3:L65-L68`). (`O-001/IX-PATH07`)
- title=`Keep the two memory grains separate.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L584): The mounted deterministic Markdown vault is the human/owner grain; E-5 `memory_facts` remains the prompt-feeding machine grain. There is no conversion or dual-write, and ELAI adapts to existing vault bytes (`O3:L7,L10-L11,L37-L46,L53-L64`). Prompt-bound personal content is barred pending the Tier-2 D-5 read wiring (`O3:L18-L20,L80-L81`). (`O-001/IX-PATH08`)
- title=`Project, inspect, and eventually edit visually.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L585): O-4 lists TaskSpecs through Tauri and renders a node-per-stage graph in Svelte. Provenance-labelled edges, J-60 last-run chrome, and missing-consumer disconnection make execution receipts and wire-dark state visible (`O4:L19-L33,L49-L71`). Tier 1 is read-only; Tier 2 writes node edits back to TaskSpec rows and adds provenance drill-down (`O4:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH09`)
- title=`Run-now shares the same backend.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L586): The canvas calls O-2’s dispatcher, which emits the same `task_spec_fired` receipt through the normal FSM. No client-side scheduler, stage runner, spec store, or separate execution event is allowed (`O4:L34-L39,L46-L47,L68-L73`). (`O-001/IX-PATH10`)
- surface=`Research topics` state=`User-editable manifest `[[research.topics]]`` lifecycle=`Existing hourly Cosmos loop enumerates topics; existing Cosmos artifacts can time-decay to `DECAYED`; drawer shows kind and last-run trust tier` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L605) (`O-001/IX-DATA001`)

- surface=`Inbox intervention card` state=`Existing dashboard surface` lifecycle=`Created only for result-bearing runs; empty runs auto-archive and retain SSB only` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L611) (`O-001/IX-DATA007`)

#### Surfaces for O-summary-wide (summary-wide premise, cross-cutting digest, workflows, invariants, silent candidates)
- The desired product is a “TEIKOKU-style personal research machine on the ELAI canvas.” (`SUMMARY/O.G.E02`) [O-SUMMARY:L9-L10 | ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L53]
- title=`Scheduled execution path (`O-2`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L279): Supervisor-plane `Cron`, `SsbEvent`, or `Manual` trigger -> persisted typed `TaskSpec` -> ordered closed-enum stages -> one journaled `task_spec_fired` row with cause and stage path -> one of the typed sinks -> intervention-card inbox only when the fire bears a result. Temporal monitoring detects missed runs; a Cron due now fires exactly once per tick. Source: O-SUMMARY:L35-L46. (`SUMMARY/WF-02`)
- title=`Guarded vault path (`O-3`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L283): O-1/O-2 `FileToBrain` request -> namespace-claims parser -> hard write-scope check -> guarded vault writer/upsert -> deterministic markdown page and `vault_write` row. A denied attempt emits `claim_violation` without producing the forbidden write. Prompt-bound reads remain separated from E-5 machine memory, and personal topics may not enter project/cloud prompts. Source: O-SUMMARY:L51-L62. (`SUMMARY/WF-03`)
- title=`Visual editing and run path (`O-4`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L287): Select WORKFLOW -> list/project O-2 TaskSpecs to typed nodes and provenance-bearing edges -> overlay last-run SSB state -> edit a node by editing its closed-enum-constrained spec row -> display missing consumers as disconnected -> `run-now` dispatches through the normal FSM -> O-2 emits the fire row. The canvas may never execute directly. Source: O-SUMMARY:L67-L77. (`SUMMARY/WF-04`)
- title=`Track validation loop` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L291): Digest success -> measure digest opens and `For-You` clicks -> after `N` days of zero engagement, decay the topic instead of preserving an unused default-off feature. Source: O-SUMMARY:L83-L84. (`SUMMARY/WF-05`)

## How the systems compose (synergy)

Cross-family composition is directed: **consumer family feature → provider feature** when an aggregate atom names a feature owned by another family. Map totals: **3010** raw mention edges, **1670** unique (consumer, provider, relation) triples, **881** structural pairs (consumer family → provider feature), **115** hub systems (provider referenced by ≥3 families), **426** distinct external provider feature IDs.

### Hub systems (load-bearing substrates)

Changing a hub without updating dependents is a system break. Below: primary hubs named in product vocabulary, each with composition narrative, consumer families, and sample evidence anchors. Full hub id list (115) is in the interaction map closing audit.

#### `SSB` — session event bus / append-only journal (phase-3B backbone)

**10 families · 43 raw edges.** PHASE 3B defines typed `action_type` + single-writer SQLite-WAL journal. Later families journal measured rows; schema bumps per letter. Coordination required around shared edit windows and prefer-reuse row budgets.

- **Consumers:** G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q (plus PHASE backbone).
- **Evidence:** `G-002/IX-015` @ G-AGG:L1236; `H-001/IX-013` @ H-AGG:L1391; `I-001/IX-007` @ I-AGG:L1163; `J-004/IX-019` @ J-AGG:L2946; `K-001/IX-008` @ K-AGG:L1194; `L-001/IX-017` @ L-AGG:L1707; `M-001/IX-016` @ M-AGG:L665; `N-001/IX-012` @ N-AGG:L763; `P-001/IX-013` @ P-AGG:L1684; `Q-002/IX-015` @ Q-AGG:L828.
- **Known gap:** phase-4D `research_*` types vs 3B 17-type CHECK (`PHASE-007/IX-017`; CF-006c).

#### `B-37` — RuntimeAdapter multi-backend substrate

**9 families · 67 raw edges.** One runtime abstraction over multi-backend routing (cloud/local/CLI/process isolation). Per-role hybrid routing and fallback chains feed almost every later agent surface.

- **Consumers:** C, D, E, I, J, K, L, N, P.
- **Evidence:** `C-005/C44-E02` @ C-AGG:L2890; D14-E27 @ D-AGG:L746; `E-006/E006-E24-002` @ E-AGG:L1656; `I-001/IX-014` @ I-AGG:L1170; `J-009/IX-005` @ J-AGG:L4820; `K-003/K24-E026` @ K-AGG:L526; `L-002/L0-E007` @ L-AGG:L438; `N-002/N13-E006` @ N-AGG:L611; `P-003/IX-005` @ P-AGG:L1724.

#### `G-2` — RRA / replay-verify evidence plane

**9 families · 63 raw edges.** Replayable run artifact (RRA) seal + `replay --verify`. Downstream units extend cassettes, retain verification, or consume the bundle for proof spines.

- **Consumers:** H, I, J, K, L, M, O, P, Q.
- **Evidence:** `H-004/IX-014` @ H-AGG:L2889; `I-006/I43-E013` @ I-AGG:L3551; `J-008/IX-015` @ J-AGG:L4450; `K-001/IX-009` @ K-AGG:L1195; `L-002/L7-E008` @ L-AGG:L578; `M-001/M5-E029` @ M-AGG:L131; `P-003/IX-011` @ P-AGG:L1730; `Q-001/Q5-E006` @ Q-AGG:L343.

#### `G-1` — taint lattice (untrusted IN-flow)

**7 families · 43 raw edges.** Untrusted tag on external bytes at ingest. Mirror on OUT-flow privacy (P-6) shares N-6’s ONE lattice (N-2 forbids a second scale).

- **Consumers:** H, J, K, L, N, O, P.
- **Evidence:** `H-002/HTG-010` @ H-AGG:L1531; `J-008/IX-015` @ J-AGG:L4450; `K-001/K20-E004` @ K-AGG:L180; `L-002/L1-E016` @ L-AGG:L519; `N-002/N6-E002` @ N-AGG:L492; `P-002/IX-004` @ P-AGG:L1698.

### Six multi-hop composition chains

#### 1. Trust spine on every external byte

```
external ingest (P-9/P-10/P-12/P-22)
  → G-1 taint Untrusted
  → N-6 lattice tier (N-2 forbids second scale)
  → G-2 RRA / SSB journal
  → G-9 redaction on export (M-3/M-4/P-3)
  → F-4 / F-5 case+quarantine when claims enter reuse
```

Evidence: `P-002/IX-004`, `P-002/IX-008`, `M-001/IX-013`, `Q-002/Q1-E012`.

#### 2. Mutation / claim honesty stack

```
C-28 mutation gate + C-29 intent
  → F-4 cant-lie / PROVEN
  → I-12 curator (must not reimplement 3F SM)  [PHASE-005/IX-006]
  → L-5 counterfactual do-test (prereqs C-29, J-16, F-4)
  → J-96 CaseNode / MintOnProof → P-15 reuse → K-18 hit-rate
```

Evidence: `SUMMARY/F4-19`; `I-004/IX-008`; `L-003/L5-E006`; `P-003/IX-003`.

#### 3. Org commerce over seat trust

```
G-8 attestation + G-2 verify + K-6 export shape
  → M-1 tier()  [gates K-24 credits, M-2 packs, M-3 report]
  → M-3 org rollup (extends K-6; J-59 isolation)
  → M-5/M-6 open verifier + golden-lock (Q-8 ceiling consumes M)
```

Evidence: `M-001/IX-004`, `M-001/IX-008`, `M-001/IX-011`; `Q-001/IX-006`.

#### 4. Orchestration economics (Q over O/I/J/H/K)

```
O-1 daemon / O-2 TaskSpec wake sites
  → Q-2 cross-family wake quorum (D-13 principle, J free-API voters)
  → I-25 router / intervention cards
  → Q-3 advisor (H-7 split, I-11 BeliefState, H-9 spend, K-2 arm)
  → Q-4 model swap (F-6 trust, 4G/4M, J rotation)

```

## Shared invariants

**34** invariant records across **7** themes (INV-A01..A06, B01..B06, C01..C09, D01..D02, E01..E03, F01..F06, G01..G02; source footer says 32 by arithmetic error on the same id ranges). Shared means asserted as a system rule in **two or more** families with atom-level anchors. Wording compressed; every INV id retained. Full per-family evidence tables: `CROSS-FAMILY-SHARED-INVARIANTS.md`.

### Theme A — Integrity / evidence

- **INV-A01 — Off-agent evidence is required.** A gate measures an artifact the generator did not write. Model self-report is not enough. Families: B, D, E, F, H, I, J, K, L, N, O, P, Q (13). Anchors e.g. `SUMMARY/SUM-0389` @ B:2197; `P-001/P4-E020` @ P:134; `Q-002/Q6-E019` @ Q:140.
- **INV-A02 — Missing evidence is FAIL (never SKIP).** Absence fails the gate (HALT / UNVOUCHED / never silent clean). Families: B, G, H, J, K, M, N, O, P, Q (+ fail-closed wording in C,D,E,F,I,L,PHASE). Anchors: `H-006/H006-H29-008`; `K-001/K0-E027`; `M-001/M6-E033`; `O-001/O0-E041`.
- **INV-A03 — Author emits; auditor enforces (no self-certify).** Generating path proposes; independent auditor/checker enforces. Families: D, F, H, I, Q (+ B/G/J wiring auditor + W-1). Anchors: `D12-006`; `SUMMARY/F6-19`; `I-002/I002-IDX-023`.
- **INV-A04 — Claims discipline (measured or tagged).** Superlative/external claims need journal-recomputable pointer or `[EXTERNAL]`/`[DESIGN]`. Families: E, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, Q. Anchors: `K-001/K1-E013`; G GD-3; `N-002/N8-E020`.
- **INV-A05 — CANT-LIE / anti-fabrication.** No fabricated measurements/anchors/clean verdicts; admission rejects inventing instruction-surface content. Families: B, C, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, N, P, PHASE, Q. Anchors: `I-001/I8-E019`; `J-007/J0-U109`; `SUMMARY/SUM-0391`.
- **INV-A06 — Journal completeness (observed effect needs a row).** Covered side-effects mediated or observed; missing row = DETERMINISTIC FAIL; dropped-event counters fail closed. Families: K primary; G/H/N/O emission doctrine. Anchors: `K-003/K21-E002`, `K21-E006`; `O-001/O0-E020`; `G-001/DG001-G0-E007`.

### Theme B — Determinism / replay

- **INV-B01 — Append-only SSB journal (no UPDATE / no DELETE).** Sealed history immutable; schema golden-locked; evolution is append-only growth. Families: B, C, D, E, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, PHASE, Q (15). Anchors: `G-001/DG001-G0-E003`; `I-001/IG-E007`; `L-002/L8-E005` (quarantine never DELETE). D held-out TOML status rewrite is a separate store, not SSB mutation.
- **INV-B02 — Controlled time and randomness (ELAI_SEED / providers).** Injected ClockProvider / SeededRng; `ELAI_SEED` pins RNG. Families: B–N, P, PHASE, Q (16). Anchors: `P0-E060`; `C-006/C15-E009`; `D5-028`; `B39-065`. Note: SeededClock tick starts at 0 regardless of ELAI_SEED (`C15-E004`).
- **INV-B03 — GD-2: metrics recomputable from journal under seed.** Human/gate-facing numbers recomputable from SSB under pinned seed or wire-dark. Families: G, H, N owners; J, K, L, Q echo. Anchors: `G-001/DG001-G0-E019`; `N-001/N0-E024`.
- **INV-B04 — Byte-identical / hash-checkable replay where claimed.** Non-clock fields byte-identical or hash-checkable; network detached on cassette replay. Families: all 17 mention; strong in B, C, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, O, PHASE. Anchors: `O-001/O1-E079`; `C-006/C15-E026`; `I-005/DII005-I44-016`. E-29 “best-effort” is losing wording vs fail-closed frozen predicates.

Families: all 17; explicit ban in B, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, L, N, O, P, Q, PHASE. Anchors: `E-001/DEEP-E001-E0-062`; `B16-014`; `G-001/DG001-G0-E042`. Supersedes early PHASE blake2 and B-16A blake2s.

### Theme C — Safety / gating

- **INV-C01 — Fail-closed is the default gate posture.** Required check fails → block/refuse. Fail-open paths must not advertise fail-closed. Families: all 17.
- **INV-C02 — W-10: Tier-1 in-process fail-closed vs Tier-2 gated.** Network/subprocess/RunPod axes split; only Tier-1 is fail-closed done-gate. Families: F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, PHASE, B (14+). Anchor: `G-001/DG001-G0-E016`.

- **INV-C08 — Authority split (harness owns gates; models generate).** Models generate; harness sizes work, owns state, runs gates, journals, decides completion. Families: B, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, P, PHASE. Anchors: `I-002/I002-IDX-023`; `K-003/K27-E006` (Codex output TAINTED DATA).

### Theme D — Budget / economics

- **INV-D01 — Hard spend / cost ceilings fail closed.** Crossing ceiling blocks/reroutes; free-lane revoke fails closed. Families: B, C, E, H, I, J, M, N, PHASE, Q. Anchors: `E-001/DEEP-E001-E0-043`; `C-002/C5-E20`; `Q-001/Q8-E003`.

**CF-043 — D-13 ModelFamily predicate wording.** Prose “different enum variants suffice” vs test requiring Qwen25Coder+Qwen25Math same-family/false. **UNRESOLVED on implementation shape → RA-006** (behavior target clear: same-family reject).

### How to use this register

1. When plan and summary disagree on status, look up the unit here first.
2. Apply the RESOLUTION line; do not re-derive from summary orientation alone.
3. If the unit is in the residual table, stop and recon before implement.
4. Wording-only deltas stay in per-family SUP inventories (518 family-local SUP/PREC total); only ship/wire/tier/disposition conflicts are lifted into CF-*.

### User-facing surfaces (E)

Windows, panels, drawers, commands, CLI verbs, flags, status displays, notifications, and other surface-tagged atoms from the aggregate. One line per atom with ID. Grouped by plan unit.

#### Surfaces for E-0 (Program index & global invariants)
- Defines the E plan as a 55-session, 55-report post-B/C/D improvement sweep. #### Surfaces for E-2 (Local LLM Speed Tricks)
- **PLANNED, 2 sessions/6-10h.** Extend B-14 streaming and B-37 sidecar without leaving `model.generate()` or breaking DoLa/ETC/steering. Coordinates `CommandWindow.svelte` edits with E-4. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-001`)
- Diagnosed latency has three surfaces: 50-200ms bursty SSE chunks, per-character DOM layout thrash, and no submit→TTFT cue. Targets <200ms “snappy” TTFT; explicitly rejects vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM migration, Skeleton-of-Thought, MoE swaps, and 12GB-tier EAGLE-3. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-002`)
- Existing path is B-14 `stream_chat`→Tauri event→CommandWindow/Palette plus B-37 `RuntimeAdapter`; prompt lookup is transparent to Rust. DoLa is harmful/disabled by default on 7B, while ETC/steering remain live. This plan calls its dashboard+sidecar delta net-new. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-003`)
- `SkeletonBubble.svelte` appears immediately on submit, shimmers, preallocates configurable height (240px default), and disappears on first token/`stream_complete` as specified by wiring/acceptance. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-005`)
- `CursorSentinel.svelte` is a CSS-only blinking caret visible while `streaming=true`; no JavaScript interval; removed on `stream_complete`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-006`)
- Prefix-KV reuse precomputes immutable system-prefix KV, keys it by blake3, clones/slices into a fresh HF `StaticCache`, invalidates on prompt change, and is gated by `ELAI_PREFIX_KV_REUSE=1`; default-off until three consecutive deterministic passes. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-008`)
- `StreamingTimingRecorded` payload is `{request_id,ttft_ms,mean_inter_chunk_ms,p50_inter_chunk_ms,p99_inter_chunk_ms,total_ms,tokens_emitted}` per stream end. It flows through `/notify` and renders a MonitorWindow histogram; frame-pacing default-on is blocked pending the data. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-009`)
- A configurable 200ms submit→stream-start threshold shows “elai is reading the project...” below the skeleton and removes it on first token. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-011`)
- Partial-Markdown state machine soft-commits an empty code-block frame when an opening fence arrives, tracks open/close state, and buffers incomplete markup to avoid flicker. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-012`)
- `test_prefix_kv_determinism.py` runs reuse on/off three times at greedy temperature 0 and requires token/byte-equivalent output; mismatch fails and keeps reuse off. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-013`)
- Frame-pacing A/B is randomized per session between default-off/default-on, logs a `snappy/slow` self-rating as `UxPacingVoteRecorded`, and uses N=5 sessions as the directional gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-014`)
- `E-2-decisions.md` records frame-pacing threshold (p50 chunk gap >100ms), prompt lookup starting value 10, three-pass KV gate, and explicit deferral/rejection of EAGLE-3, vLLM, Skeleton-of-Thought and MoE. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-015`)
- Produced surfaces are `FramePacer`, Skeleton/Cursor components, `StreamingTimingRecorded`, `UxPacingVoteRecorded`, prompt-lookup/prefix-KV paths and determinism test. They consume CommandWindow, `stream_chat`, SettingsWindow and are reachable from dashboard SSE and CLI REPL sidecar calls. Smoke e... (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-016`)
- Negative contract: no pacing TODO/no-pacing literals, no vLLM/SGLang imports, and no new `model.generate` call bypassing the existing LogitsProcessor chain. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-017`)
- Deterministic checks require imports/files, both sidecar env hooks and `StaticCache`, both SSB variants, passing KV byte-equivalence, and queryable p50/TTFT rows in SQLite after a 200-token stream. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-018`)
- Done gates: pacing within ±10%; no skeleton flicker; cursor lifetime correct; prompt lookup lossless at temp 0; prefix reuse passes 3×; every stream end has all timing fields; cancel path works; LogitsProcessors stay attached; no new dependency; production unwrap count does not increase. - Test inventory: three burst-pattern pacing test; skeleton lifecycle; KV equivalence; five-prompt prompt-lookup equivalence; timing/vote SSB contracts; bursty mock-SSE CommandWindow integration. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E2-020`)

#### Surfaces for E-4 (Chat UX Critique)
- CommandWindow is the trust-forming surface; the plan groups bubble affordances, session rails, and hard model-output rules and targets confidence, sycophancy, instruction retention, re-anchoring, doom loops, evidence-backed completion, clarification, interrupt, handoff, and intervention. (`E-003/E003-E4-001`)
- ChatReflectPipeline AUDITOR emits claim wrappers; passed FILE_CHECK/SOURCE_CHECK/TEST_CHECK/WEB_CHECK maps to Verified or ReadFromSource, no grounding maps to FromTraining, and a low-confidence mcp_think status echo maps to Guessed. (`E-003/E003-E4-004`)
- CommandWindow renders a pill before every factual claim, and E-1 memory_notes can persist the claim as fact_type=claim with confidence_tier and provenance. (`E-003/E003-E4-005`)
- PinnedRulesPanel.svelte reads rules.db ACTIVE rows plus session ad-hoc constraints and renders them in the CommandWindow sidebar. (`E-003/E003-E4-009`)
- Re-anchor re-injects the system prompt, first user message, and active rules, emits session_re_anchored, exposes cadence in SettingsWindow, and shows a toast. (`E-003/E003-E4-012`)
- Completion phrases including done, complete, finished, and successfully implemented require at least one file diff, audit-verdict/test row, or deterministic-check pass. (`E-003/E003-E4-016`)
- The initial ambiguity heuristic is task length under 50 characters plus missing action verb plus no target file/scope; B-38’s continuous ambiguity score replaces it when shipped. (`E-003/E003-E4-018`)
- An ambiguous task produces exactly one clarifier card with at most three yes/no questions; after one response it proceeds without another round and emits one_shot_clarifier_emitted/resolved. (`E-003/E003-E4-019`)
- Default output is action plus one-line why plus one-line risk; /verbose applies long form for the next N turns or until /terse. (`E-003/E003-E4-020`)
- agents/voice.toml gains a verbosity section; fact_type=expertise is read before TRIAGE, is per-language on a five-stage Dreyfus scale, calibrates jargon/terserness, and defaults to competent until E-5 rows exist. (`E-003/E003-E4-021`)

#### Surfaces for E-14 (Browser E2E Agents)
- B-24 and B-42 are shipped prerequisites, C-7/C-16 are planned, and the work augments those surfaces while being parallel-safe with E-11/E-12/E-13/E-15. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:4-6) (`E-002/E14-002`)
- Cloudflare/Turnstile bypass is prohibited; detection must skip protected flows because headless automation is fingerprinted and bypass poses legal/ToS risk. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:8-10) (`E-002/E14-003`)

- ax_snapshot.rs defines AxNode with role/name/state, AxSnapshot, and AxSnapshotReader::from_disk; every Tier 1 invocation returns AX snapshot, screenshot, and console-log paths, and downstream rules match role/name rather than pixels. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:38-40) (`E-002/E14-006`)
- PlaywrightWebAdapter invokes Playwright 1.56+ snapshot-to-disk in a Tier-C sandbox and writes ax-snapshot.json, screenshot.png, console.log, and trace.zip with retries=2, trace_on_retry=true, animations disabled, and deterministic seed. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:42) (`E-002/E14-007`)
- Axe runs on every Tier 1 web check: serious/critical immediately fail, moderate passes Tier 1 but advises Tier 2/dashboard, and minor is logged only. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:44) (`E-002/E14-008`)
- Stagehand act/extract/observe is a Tier-C local-Node fallback only when AXTree role/name lookup fails; action sequences are cached by url_hash plus goal_hash at ~/.cache/elai/stagehand and replayed across DOM drift. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:46) (`E-002/E14-009`)
- Tier 2 must return schema-constrained JSON with pass and failures containing region/reason/confidence in [0,1]; free text raises VlmInvalidOutput and degrades to HumanReview. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:48) (`E-002/E14-010`)
- HybridDiff avoids VLM when SSIM_delta is below configurable threshold 0.02; at or above threshold it crops delta-map bounding boxes and sends only changed regions to Tier 2. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:50) (`E-002/E14-011`)
- Verdict aggregation is exhaustive: T1 fail stays Fail; T1 pass/T2 pass is Pass; T1 pass/T2 fail is HumanReview; T1 pass/T2 unavailable is Degraded; absent T1 with either T2 result is HumanReview. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:52) (`E-002/E14-013`)
- DeployPreviewWorker mirrors cosmos_worker, polls Vercel/Netlify checks every 30 seconds using provider/api_token/project_ids, may fall back to cURL retry/backoff, and starts live smoke validation on the first HTTP 200. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:54) (`E-002/E14-014`)
- Deploy-preview execution is project-opt-in with enabled=false by default and emits polling_started, ready, failed, and app_validation_complete actions. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:54) (`E-002/E14-015`)
- SaasJourneyRunner creates one isolated browser context per simulated user, captures outbound mail/webhooks through network mocks, asserts captured notifications, and loads project steps/assertions from .elai_cc/journeys/{project}.toml. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:56) (`E-002/E14-016`)
- CfDetector checks challenge HTML, Turnstile widgets, and JA4 mismatch banners, returns Skipped(ReasonExternalProtection), never bypasses, and emits cf_protection_detected. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:58) (`E-002/E14-017`)
- DeployPreviewArtifact is added to the Cosmos types; until C-16 ships, the worker runs through a standalone task-runner tick loop and is migrated into CosmosStage later. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:60) (`E-002/E14-018`)
- MediaValidationPanel adds an AX role/name tree, severity-filtered axe list, SSIM/VLM gauge, deployment badge, multi-context journey timeline, and protection-skip banner. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:62) (`E-002/E14-019`)
- Three commands expose recent AX snapshots, axe findings, and deploy status. (E-14_browser_e2e_agents.md:62) (`E-002/E14-020`)

#### Surfaces for E-15 (Sandboxed Exec)
- E-15 hardens Tier-C execution with Firecracker hot snapshots, argument-filtered seccomp, explicit privilege-drop ordering, no chroot lane, allowlisted researcher networking, per-baby-step ephemerality, and the Windows AppContainer/Job/LowIL trio. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:1-3`) (`E-005/E005-E15-001`)
- It augments planned B-18/C-11, reuses B-37 `TierCSpawn` and existing sandbox policy, replaces the Phase-0/1 chroot fallback, and is parallel-safe with E-11 through E-14. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:4-5,12-20`) (`E-005/E005-E15-002`)
- The source treats the runc bind-mount CVEs, Pyodide host-bridge RCE, prompt-injection escapes, and persistent malicious package installs as the threat model; snapshot restore evicts persistence but does not prevent the first download. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:8-10,229`) (`E-005/E005-E15-003`)
- `FirecrackerHotPool` stores `HashMap<(AgentId,AgentRole),SnapshotHandle>` with `restore_budget_ms:200`; first spawn cold-boots and CoW-snapshots, later same-pair spawns restore. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,68-70,154`) (`E-005/E005-E15-004`)
- Snapshots live at `.elai_cc/sessions/{session_id}/snapshots/{agent_id}-{role}.snap`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41`) (`E-005/E005-E15-005`)
- A restore exceeding 200 ms falls back to cold boot and emits `firecracker_restore_slow`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,63,176`) (`E-005/E005-E15-006`)
- Every restore regenerates TCP-ISN seed, `/dev/random` pool, and hostname salt and emits `snapshot_uniqueness_regenerated`; ten restores must prove all three orthogonal. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:41,63,65,140-142,156,173`) (`E-005/E005-E15-007`)
- `IPC_BASELINE` denies `socket()` completely; `NETWORK_EXTRA` allows only address family 2/10 and socket type 1/2, expressly denying AF_UNIX, AF_NETLINK, AF_PACKET, AF_BLUETOOTH, and raw sockets. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:43,108-110,157,174`) (`E-005/E005-E15-008`)
- seccomp checks scalar arguments only; `sockaddr*` destination enforcement belongs to veth/iptables because kernel BPF cannot dereference it. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:43`) (`E-005/E005-E15-009`)
- `clone_cb` must run `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` before the full `PR_CAPBSET_DROP` loop and install seccomp last; inversion is a tested failure. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:45,112-114,158,177`) (`E-005/E005-E15-010`)
- All chroot setup is removed rather than deprecated; supported lanes become Firecracker with KVM, gVisor without KVM, and AppContainer on Windows, with a `chroot_removed` migration note. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:16,47,87,116-118,159,178`) (`E-005/E005-E15-011`)
- `GvisorBackend` invokes `runsc` with `platform=systrap` when `kvm_available()==false`, accepts an expected 10-20% syscall overhead, and emits selected backend on every launch. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:49,71,160,185`) (`E-005/E005-E15-012`)
- `ResearcherNetSetup` creates a veth pair/netns and an iptables OUTPUT allowlist for resolved/pinned curated mirror IPs and trusted DNS; everything else is `REJECT`, not `DROP`, to return fast `EHOSTUNREACH`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:51,72,144-146,161`) (`E-005/E005-E15-013`)
- Researchers have zero capabilities including `CAP_NET_RAW` and `CAP_NET_ADMIN`; allowed FQDNs and resolvers come from `[researcher.net]` and are resolved once at boot. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:51,161,175`) (`E-005/E005-E15-014`)
- Each baby step calls `spawn_from_snapshot`; the long-lived “1” control plane remains, while all four data-plane workers are newly restored, never process-reused, and emit `agent_forked_from_snapshot`. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:53,81-84,162,179`) (`E-005/E005-E15-015`)
- `PyodideBridge` is a file stub while Pyodide is absent; any future import is blocked until `globalThis.require`, `process`, and Node child_process/fs/net handles are pruned before execution. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:55,73,90,163,181,227`) (`E-005/E005-E15-016`)
- The Windows fallback requires a unique per-agent AppContainer SID with zero capabilities, `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`, active-process limit one, and a Low Mandatory Label on the working directory. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:57,91,136-138,164,180`) (`E-005/E005-E15-017`)
- Snapshot GC is LRU by `max_snapshots=64` and age by 24 hours since restore, emits `snapshot_evicted`, and reports directory size to the auditor. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:59,125,165,176`) (`E-005/E005-E15-018`)
- `get_sandbox_status` gains backend, restore p50, snapshot count, uniqueness count, allowed hosts, and last-ten blocked attempts; `SandboxBackendPanel` mounts in OrchestrationDrawer. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:63,80,94,168,188,197-198`) (`E-005/E005-E15-022`)
- POSIX and PowerShell measurement scripts boot 20 sandboxes and persist cold/restore p50/p95 in `metrics/sandbox_perf.toml`; the end-to-end p50 acceptance threshold is under 100 ms. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:65,148-150,155,170,189`) (`E-005/E005-E15-024`)
- `SandboxBackend::{Firecracker,Gvisor,AppContainer}` refactors `launch_agent`, consumes `SandboxConfig`, registers Firecracker as `TierCSpawn`, and is reachable from CLI, dashboard submit, and isolation tests. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:67-84`) (`E-005/E005-E15-025`)
- New sandbox code bans TODO/unimplemented, any retained chroot or blanket socket allow, inverted ordering, unpruned Pyodide bridges, incomplete Windows Job isolation, `Box<dyn Error>`, and non-test unwraps. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:85-93,169`) (`E-005/E005-E15-026`)
- Five-step malicious-install smoke expects one backend event per spawn, five fork and uniqueness events, blocked unknown egress, distinct PIDs, clean restored state, and an LRU-bounded snapshot directory. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:95-98`) (`E-005/E005-E15-027`)
- Deterministic static checks require three new backend/network modules, argument-family tokens in allow/deny paths, privilege tokens in correct order, zero production chroot hits, snapshot helpers, six events, and four TOML tables. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:100-130`) (`E-005/E005-E15-028`)
- Seccomp tests cover both allowed families/types and denied UNIX/NETLINK/PACKET/RAW; network tests cover allow, reject, trusted DNS, and both dropped caps. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:172-175`) (`E-005/E005-E15-030`)
- The file plan creates Firecracker, gVisor, networking, conditional Pyodide, panel, and two measurement scripts; modifies sandbox dispatch/policy/task runner/SSB/config/tests/dashboard. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:183-198`) (`E-005/E005-E15-032`)
- If measured baby-step p50 exceeds 100 ms, a prebooted warm pool is deferred as a follow-up. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:221-222`) (`E-005/E005-E15-033`)
- Windows Firecracker depends on Hyper-V detection through WMI and likely degrades to AppContainer+Job; the decision must be documented. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:223`) (`E-005/E005-E15-034`)
- Netns teardown cost is unmeasured; only if it dominates 100 ms may a netns be reused within a session, while session boundaries still tear down. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:225`) (`E-005/E005-E15-036`)
- gVisor must be benchmarked on cargo/npm/pip; overhead over 300 ms triggers documentation and possible Kata consideration. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:226`) (`E-005/E005-E15-037`)
- E-11 PackageVerifier prevents suspect downloads while E-15 only evicts their state; both are explicitly complementary. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:229,234`) (`E-005/E005-E15-039`)
- Apple/container is macOS-only and deferred; managed sandboxes are catalogued but not chosen because the system is local-first. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:218-219`) (`E-005/E005-E15-041`)
- The source estimates three sessions/12 hours and contains no shipped/completed marker. (`E-15_sandboxed_exec.md:3`) (`E-005/E005-E15-042`)
- Pool keys/path/budgets/cold fallback, uniqueness regeneration, complete socket matrix, REJECT networking/DNS/caps, control/data-plane lifecycle, conditional Pyodide, Windows trio fields, GC/config/dashboard/measurement/test and fallback details are additions: E15-004..042. (`E-005/E005-SD-E15-ADD`)

#### Surfaces for E-16 (VLM Image Validation)
- E-16 is explicitly a delta on shipped B-24: add AXTree YAML, anti-sycophancy prompting, swap-order evaluation, and bounded LPIPS convergence without re-authoring the existing tier architecture. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:1-3) (`E-002/E16-001`)
- B-24 and B-37 are shipped prerequisites, C-7 is planned, and E-17/C-7/C-8 are parallel-safe; D-13 is a sibling cross-family design rather than being pre-empted. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:4-6,19-26) (`E-002/E16-002`)
- Existing B-24 is described as already having pHash/SSIM/LPIPS, axe, OCR/media tooling, two VLM modes, an RCE loop, and 113 passing tests, but lacking the four new controls. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:8-17) (`E-002/E16-003`)
- The motivating failures are leading-prompt sycophancy, greater-than-ten-point pairwise position bias, missing deterministic AXTree snapshots, and unbounded/no-convergence RCE iteration. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:10-17) (`E-002/E16-004`)
- AXTreeAdapter calls page.ariaSnapshot after web rendering, stores YAML in the Tier 1 result, compares by render task ID, emits axtree_mismatch on drift, targets under 100 ms CPU-only, and is skipped for non-web adapters. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:39-41) (`E-002/E16-005`)
- neutralize_query removes leading executor claims while preserving the semantic request; contrastive_decode compares neutral and leading variants and returns agree/divergent plus divergence_score. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:43) (`E-002/E16-006`)
- Primary Tier 2 always uses neutral framing; the leading variant is confined to contrastive comparison. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:43) (`E-002/E16-007`)
- Before/after candidate comparison runs in [A,B] and [B,A] order; only agreement can pass, disagreement enters HumanReview and emits swap_order_disagreement. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:45) (`E-002/E16-008`)
- RCE converges when LPIPS(previous,current) is below 0.02, the critic reports no actionable differences, or iteration reaches the hard cap of five; the existing CPU ONNX LPIPS model is reused. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:47) (`E-002/E16-009`)
- InternVL3.5 is a second opinion when Qwen’s verdict has low log probability or sycophancy score exceeds a threshold; both must agree to pass and disagreement routes to HumanReview. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:49) (`E-002/E16-010`)
- The second opinion reuses B-37 runtime configuration and adds second_opinion_backend rather than introducing a runtime implementation. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:49) (`E-002/E16-011`)

- Twenty identical renders measure AXTree YAML drift; above one percent triggers fallback to an axe-only deterministic gate. (E-16_vlm_image_validation.md:59) (`E-002/E16-016`)

#### Surfaces for E-18 (Tool-Use Reliability)
- The tool path is hardened with XGrammar, a Hermes envelope, SEARCH/REPLACE fences, one-shot error-aware recovery, and ToolResult spill, addressing malformed JSON, escape bugs, retry loops, edit disorientation, package hallucination, and long responses. (`E-003/E003-E18-001`)
- Grammar masking requires the Hermes <tool_call>...</tool_call> envelope and makes the known fenced-json fallback impossible at token selection. (`E-003/E003-E18-005`)
- Tier-2 validation failure or a SEARCH/REPLACE miss gets exactly one reprompt containing a structured <tool_error>; a second failure escalates to .claude/agents/fixer.md. (`E-003/E003-E18-009`)
- ToolResult inline content is capped at 8K tokens; overflow writes .elai_cc/sessions/{id}/spill/{uuid}.txt and returns spill_ref. (`E-003/E003-E18-012`)
- Before Edit/Bash touches Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, or package.json, registry_check verifies package name and last-published age against crates.io/PyPI/npm. (`E-003/E003-E18-014`)
- Args hashes use blake3 and dedupe emits progress_marker_emitted/duplicate_tool_call_deduped. (`E-003/E003-E18-019`)
- Cap’n Proto/postcard IPC migration is deferred to E-18.C until tunneled-WSL2 latency is measured. (`E-003/E003-E18-021`)
- AgentDrawer gains retry-exhausted and spill counters. (`E-003/E003-E18-026`)
- Deterministic checks verify processor/warmup, envelope grammar, fences/guard, retry, spill, registry verification, and an SSB package rejection. (`E-003/E003-E18-028`)
- Contracts fuzz envelope/compile failure, twenty edit fixtures with ≥95% tier-one hit rate, exactly-one retry/fixer escalation, 50K-token spill, registry cases, token-level path filtering, and boot-time schema warmup. (`E-003/E003-E18-030`)
- server.py, sidecar, dispatchers, IPC, SSB, and AgentDrawer are modified; search_replace, package_verify, one_shot_retry, and E-18 decisions are created. (`E-003/E003-E18-031`)
- Future language fence collisions require guard extension; registry latency should use caching; legitimate fresh packages need explicit --allow-fresh-package with audit logging. (`E-003/E003-E18-033`)
- The orientation summary describes malformed JSON being reshaped and first-attempt patch success; the original instead rejects/masks malformed output and permits one error-embedded retry, so “first attempt” is an acceptance aspiration only for the matcher fixtures, not a universal guarantee. (`E-003/E003-E18-038`)
