#### Surfaces for E-19 (Reasoning Quality)
- Four danger zones are unconditional/confirmatory 7B L2, intrinsic-only L4 value, breadth/depth pruning, and same-pipeline L6 verification. Six-layer prevalence and paper measurements are rationale, not implementation results. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-002`)
- Reuses B-39 N=4 sampling, B-41 auditor, B-27 hybrid path, MistakeBook/micro-reflection and InterrogationTree; E-19 inserts a pre-L2 gate and composes local diversity with D-13 cross-family review. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-003`)
- `ConfidenceGate` computes self-certainty/logit margin from N=4 L1 candidates. Route table: score ≥0.80 skips L2+L3; `[0.40,0.80)` runs L2; `<0.40` goes directly to L3. Emits score/skip/direct-route rows. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-004`)
- L4 `AuditorVerifierScore` is deterministic pass/fail+`rule_applied` and combines with intrinsic signals at weights auditor=.6, mean_logprob=.2, cosine=.2; each node emits `L4PrmLiteScore`; D-2 later swaps in PPM. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-006`)
- L6 promotion requires agreement between fresh-RNG-seed L1 and a rotated rules.db L3 MCQ set; pass/disagree have separate SSB events. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-009`)
- Calibration corpus is 200 production traces at `.elai_cc/eval/reasoning/`; tune 0.80 by ROC Youden-J and persist `[reasoning] l2_threshold` plus `calibrated_at`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-012`)
- Wiring exports nine reasoning APIs and eleven events; consumes chat-reflect, micro-reflection, MistakeBook, InterrogationTree, auditor and taxonomy; reachable from task/role reasoning. Trivial-task smoke expects L2 skip, easy budget and calibration artifact/UI fields. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-013`)
- Done gates preserve exact thresholds/weights/branch counts/schema/routes, require D-2 upgrade documentation and prevent “always reflect” regression. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-016`)
- File lifecycle creates self-certainty/typed-CoT/TTC/PRM-lite/LToT/L6 modules, two eval files and decision doc; modifies actual `crates/reasoning/src/chat_reflect.rs`, micro-reflection, task runner, SSB and ReasoningDrawer. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-018`)
- **CONDITIONAL prior art only:** SE-Agent is per-task trajectory search, not DGM/self-mod; its reported scores are rationale and README-only 80% must not be cited. Population is discarded after each task. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-019`)
- Missing operator is segment recombination across scored branches, but importing SE-Agent’s LLM-judge reward is forbidden. It is cloud/hard-only, never local default, and waits for off-agent fitness/GAP-1 after main E-19. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-020`)
- Conditional `recombine_segments` makes ≤2 candidates from ≥2 parents, reuses PRM-lite/off-agent scoring, keeps only strict parent-beating results, emits `l4_recombination_applied`, and must beat BestOfN on ≥30 hard tasks or be dropped. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-021`)
- Risks/fallbacks: calibrate 0.80 or retire L2 if wrong→right rate stays negligible; PRM-lite is syntactic only; lateral count may fall to 1; L6 diversity config defaults on HEAVY/off FOCUSED if latency fails; NF4 accuracy remains unaddressed; difficulty heuristic may gain historical cosine. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-022`)
- Next gates: D-2 replaces PRM-lite; D-13 adds cross-family axis; D-3 aggregates scores/verdicts; retire L2 if flip rate <2%; autonomous full-task waits for ≥90% L6 diversity pass on holdout; recombination remains conditional. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E19-023`)
- Extend crates/orchestrator/src/reasoning/. (`SUMMARY/E-19.F07`)
- Extend crates/orchestrator/src/chat_reflect.rs. (`SUMMARY/E-19.F08`)

#### Surfaces for E-20 (Local/Cloud Routing)
- Replace all-or-nothing HYBRID escalation with a calibrated logprob/entropy cascade, add pre-dispatch difficulty classification, first-class privacy blocking, monthly-burn visibility, and role/task-shape-aware cloud selection (L1-L2). (`E-004/E004.E20.EX001`)
- B-27 and C-5 are planned prerequisites/extensions, B-37 is shipped, B-22 owns adjacent role schema, D-10 is orthogonal, and C-6/C-7 consume the CloudPanel additions (L4-L5, L26-L34). (`E-004/E004.E20.EX002`)
- Local inference surfaces `confidence_score = -entropy_of_first_token_distribution`; probe/perplexity signals are required and verbalized self-confidence is forbidden (L53). (`E-004/E004.E20.EX004`)
- Fine-tuning on ELAI traces and a cheaper activation-probe router are deferred to E-20.B until labeled rows/hidden states exist (L57, L235, L246). (`E-004/E004.E20.EX008`)
- Before every cloud escalation, an L1 privacy gate scans AKIA/sk/JWT/private-key/AWS-account patterns, environment names/shell-expansion sigils, denylisted credential paths, and an optional ML PII classifier (L59). (`E-004/E004.E20.EX009`)

#### Surfaces for E-24 (Agent Protocols / MCP)
- E-24 is a 2-3-session, 8-10-hour MCP hardening plan: external MCP only, with schema pins, description sanitization, budgets, Streamable HTTP, and a pre-call guard; full MCP internal IPC, LLM gateways, and A2A without a consumer are rejected/deferred. (`E-24:1-6,10-14,187-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-001`)
- It depends on B-37 plus planned C-35/C-39/C-42/B-19/B-20, extends B-3’s existing bridge contract, consumes E-22 lazy schemas, and shares a prompt-decision primitive with E-25. (`E-24:4-5,16-23,193,197-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-002`)
- `pin_or_verify` canonicalizes the full `tools/list` JSON with tool-name sorting and stable serde maps, hashes it with blake3 only, and records `pinned_hash`, `pinned_at`, and `pinned_version` at `.elai_cc/.elai/mcp/pins/{server_url}.toml`. (`E-24:39,55-57,69-70,77,92-96`) (`E-006/E006-E24-003`)
- First connect returns `PinStatus::Pinned`; later equality returns `Verified`; mismatch returns `Violation`, blocks by default with `mcp_schema_pin_violation`, and requires explicit `elai mcp pin update <server>` to repin. (`E-24:39,56-57,85-87,120-122,131,137`) (`E-006/E006-E24-004`)
- Every list response passes `sanitize_description` against five pattern families: fenced commands, role tags, instruction-override phrases, shell-command prefixes, and external URL `?data=` exfiltration; each match emits `mcp_sanitization_rule_applied {rule_id,replacement_count}`. (`E-24:41,58-59,... (`E-006/E006-E24-005`)
- `[mcp.budgets]` defaults `tools/list` to 5,000 tokens/server; token cost uses verified tiktoken-rs or chars/4, and over-budget lists drop the lowest-ranked allowlist tail first. (`E-24:43,60-61,73,80,133,146`) (`E-006/E006-E24-006`)
- Budget enforcement returns `EnforceReport{dropped,kept_tokens}`, emits `mcp_budget_enforced {dropped_tools}`, and performs no drops when E-22 lazy schemas already fit. (`E-24:43,60-61,133,197-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-007`)
- Streamable HTTP uses one POST endpoint client→server with optional SSE server→client; SSE-only remains solely as `transport:sse_legacy`, opt-in, with startup `mcp_legacy_sse_transport`. (`E-24:45,79,102-103,134,147`) (`E-006/E006-E24-008`)
- `pre_mcp_call_decision(tool,params)` sends sanitized tool/parameters to a fast local Qwen-3B sidecar and requires JSON `GuardDecision::{Allow,Deny(reason),Ask(reason)}`. (`E-24:47,62-63,68,74,105-107,135`) (`E-006/E006-E24-009`)
- Deny blocks and emits `mcp_llm_guard_blocked`; Ask pauses for dashboard confirmation; the handler must be shared with E-25 rather than duplicated. (`E-24:47,135,148,197-199`) (`E-006/E006-E24-010`)
- Startup allows localhost:8100, 127.0.0.1:8100, api.anthropic.com, or an explicitly confirmed dev override; other gateway URLs emit `anthropic_gateway_detected`, and hard blocking occurs only with `--strict-no-gateway`. (`E-24:49,72,78,109-111,136,149`) (`E-006/E006-E24-011`)
- Public CLI surfaces include `elai mcp pin <server>` and `elai mcp pin update <server>`; bridge integration points are initialize→pin, handle_list_tools→sanitize+budget, and call_tool→LLM guard. (`E-24:64,71-75,137,159`) (`E-006/E006-E24-014`)
- `McpStatusPanel.svelte` (or the existing panel) exposes pin state, budget enforcement, and last guard decision through `get_mcp_status`. (`E-24:83,167-168`) (`E-006/E006-E24-015`)

#### Surfaces for E-35 (Structured Output 2026)
- E-35 is a 2-3-session, 10-14-hour planned substrate for E-18/E-19/E-20: XGrammar, INSTRUCTOR/GRAMMAR modes, model-aware tool parsing, SEARCH/REPLACE, CodeAct, cloud strict schemas, and grammar caching; no completion marker is present. (`E-35:1-6,243-252`) (`E-006/E006-E35-001`)
- It requires shipped B-37/B-7, precedes planned E-18, feeds E-19/E-20 and planned B-20/B-28, and must preserve the existing DoLa/ETC/steering chain. (`E-35:4-5,18-29,241,245-249`) (`E-006/E006-E35-002`)
- `XGrammarLogitsProcessor` wraps `GrammarMatcher` and Transformers `LogitsProcessor`, inserts after existing processors, and `compile_all_schemas_at_boot` precompiles an assumed 8-role ×8-block matrix. (`E-35:49,78-80,90-91,96,164`) (`E-006/E006-E35-003`)
- Grammar keys are `(role,block,blake3(schema_canonical_json))`; schema compile failure is a loud startup error, hashes are blake3 only, and synchronous per-request compilation is prohibited. (`E-35:49,63,104,107,164-165,175`) (`E-006/E006-E35-004`)
- `ToolParserVariant` resolves from `model.config.name_or_path` or `ELAI_TOOL_PARSER_VARIANT={hermes|qwen_tools}`; Qwen2.5-Coder uses `<tools>...</tools>`, non-Coder Qwen2.5-Instruct uses Hermes, and the envelope grammar follows the resolved variant. (`E-35:55,81,103,168,183,237`) (`E-006/E006-E35-007`)
- `SearchReplaceMatcher` uses `<<< ELAI_SEARCH`, `=== ELAI_REPLACE`, and `>>> ELAI_END`; `DelimiterCollisionGuard` scans those and git-conflict markers, falling to whole-file rewrite on collision. (`E-35:57,84,93,99,135-137,169,186`) (`E-006/E006-E35-008`)
- New `AgentRole::Runner` emits `CodeActAction{python_code,tool_allowlist}`, runs Python through existing subprocess/path allowlist/timeout, exposes only allowlisted tools as functions, and caps an action at 200 lines absent explicit override. (`E-35:59,85-87,94,98,105,170,187`) (`E-006/E006-E35-009`)
- CodeAct emits `codeact_action_executed {python_lines,tools_invoked,turn_saved_count}`; the report’s +20% success/−30% turns is external API-Bank grounding rather than an ELAI result. (`E-35:14,59,71,214,234`) (`E-006/E006-E35-010`)
- `CloudGroundingClient` passes Anthropic beta `structured-outputs-2025-11-13` plus schema, OpenAI `strict:true`, or Gemini `responseJsonSchema`, and emits `cloud_strict_schema_applied {provider,schema_hash}`. (`E-35:61,92,100,171,188`) (`E-006/E006-E35-011`)
- Legacy vendor `json_object` is unreachable/refused loudly through `legacy_json_object_refused`; it never serves as a syntax-only fallback. (`E-35:61,69,102,153-159,172`) (`E-006/E006-E35-012`)
- Compiled grammars persist at `.elai_cc/.elai_cc/grammar_cache/{hash}.bin`; boot cache hits skip recompilation and `grammar_cache_loaded {compiled_count,cache_hits,cache_misses,total_compile_ms}` records the result. (`E-35:63,80,96,115,158-159,165,190`) (`E-006/E006-E35-013`)
- DCCD numeric fallback is deferred/off by default behind `ELAI_DCCD_ENABLED=1` for CSQ numeric counterfactuals and auditor numeric evidence until a private eval confirms uplift. (`E-35:65,73,238,250`) (`E-006/E006-E35-014`)
- Routing to lm-format-enforcer as default is refused with `structured_engine_rejected` and falls to XGrammar; lm-format-enforcer remains only a tokenizer-edge fallback. (`E-35:67,73,102,111,173`) (`E-006/E006-E35-015`)
- Ten planned SSB variants are `XgrammarMaskApplied|InstructorModeActivated|GrammarModeActivated|CodeactActionExecuted|SearchReplaceTier1Hit|SearchReplaceCollisionFallback|CloudStrictSchemaApplied|GrammarCacheLoaded|StructuredEngineRejected|LegacyJsonObjectRefused`. #### Surfaces for E-36 (Document Vision RAG)
- Text RAG remains primary for grep-able content. Vision retrieval is additive only for diagrams/scans/screens/slides; VLM captions are retrieval evidence, never authoritative grounding. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-002`)
- `elai doctor knowledge-models --vision` probes presence, tokenizer hash and size. Default `[knowledge.vision_retriever] model="colmodernvbert"`; alternate ColQwen2.5-v0.2; models live under `models_dir_path()`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-004`)
- Cosmos gains `Diagram`, `ArchImage`, `Screenshot`, `ScannedDoc` schemas. Diagram stale-checks source **or** render; the other three stale-check source-file blake3. `ParserBackend` includes Paddle/MinerU/Dolphin plus three cloud parsers. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-007`)
- `[knowledge.vision_rag] enabled=false` is a hard shipping default. Disabled ingest stores caption+hash for visually rich inputs but skips multi-vectors; enabled stores the index. `VisionRagPolicyDecision` records enabled/budget/actual storage. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-010`)
- Cloud parser fallback threshold defaults .7 and is eligible only outside `--mode local`; local refuses and logs `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`; cloud cost consumes task spend ceiling. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-011`)
- Separate 50-query gold set evaluates ColModernVBERT vs ColQwen at nDCG@5/Recall@5/MRR. At least one backend must reach nDCG@5≥.50 before any policy default-enables vision. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-012`)
- CosmosDrawer extension or `VisionRAGDrawer` shows index state, storage, parse confidence and latest verdict/reliability; Tauri exposes `get_vision_artifact_status` and `get_vision_artifact_check_recent`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-013`)
- Wiring exports chunkers/schemas/artifact types/parser enum/verdict/reliability/RRF4, doctor probe and five events: `VisionChunkEmitted`, `VisionFallbackTriggered`, `VisualArtifactCheckVerdict`, `VisionRagPolicyDecision`, `DocParserCloudFallbackBlockedByMode`. Entry points are CLI, query pipeline,... (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E36-014`)

- PreToolUse rejects Bash/filesystem/database/network mutation whenever any argument derives from WebTier or McpTool and records the tool, provenanced argv, and rejecting origin (L62). (`E-004/E004.E37.EX017`)

#### Surfaces for E-39 (Cost Token Economics)
- The objective converts soft task/day spend warnings into a hard cooperative abort, adds self-verification, request/dollar velocity limits, local difficulty routing, prompt-cache discipline, and three low-cost/free runtime routes. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:1-3) (`E-002/E39-001`)
- E-39 extends planned B-27 and C-5 and shipped B-37; it is parallel-safe with E-36/E-37/E-38/E-40 with their costs/legal posture cross-referenced. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:4-6) (`E-002/E39-002`)
- The safety premise is that telemetry alone cannot stop wallet loops or retry storms; the system must refuse subsequent calls and terminate the active task. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:8-10,21-25) (`E-002/E39-003`)
- The plan records May-2026 price/cache assumptions, a five-minute cache TTL hazard, local marginal-cost assumptions, and claimed cascade savings; two paper identifiers are explicitly marked for verification. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:12-19) (`E-002/E39-004`)
- B-27 supplies mode/spend schema, C-5 supplies cap errors/warning default/retry cap/estimator/BYOE, C-46 may supply the classifier, B-37 hosts backends, and C-4 hosts related spend display. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:28-35) (`E-002/E39-005`)
- When task spend exceeds its cap, abort_task_on_cap_breach waits for the current paid call, records its cost, drops pending writes, returns a partial result marked aborted_by_spend_cap, and emits TaskAbortedBySpendCap with spent/cap/last_action. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:57-59) (`E-002/E39-006`)
- Per-role caps are configured for executor, auditor, scope_planner, and memory_writer and tracked in a task-context role-to-spend map; the proposed starting relationship is auditor at twice executor pending user feedback. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:61,251) (`E-002/E39-007`)
- VelocityCapEnforcer maintains OneMin, TenMin, OneHour, and TwentyFourHour rolling windows over requests and dollars; a breach aborts and emits window/count/limit evidence. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:63,81-85) (`E-002/E39-008`)
- Before hybrid cloud escalation, local Qwen verifies failed output into Continue, Retry, or Escalate JSON; Continue accepts it, Retry makes one more local attempt, and Escalate calls cloud. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:65) (`E-002/E39-009`)
- Every AutoMix decision emits AutomixVerifierVerdict, and acceptance targets more than half of failed-output cases avoiding cloud on a thirty-step ablation. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:65,175-180) (`E-002/E39-010`)
- Cost routing combines a local [0,1] difficulty score from task trigrams, touched-symbol centrality, and reference-task cosine with remaining budget. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:67) (`E-002/E39-011`)
- Routing is deterministic by matrix: easy routes local regardless of budget; hard+ample uses Sonnet; hard+tight uses Haiku or DeepSeekFlash; very-hard+critical uses Opus only with explicit confirmation. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:67) (`E-002/E39-012`)
- Every cloud request marks system prompt, project spec, repository manifest, and tool schema cacheable while keeping variable content suffix-only; ttl accepts 5min or 1hour and defaults to 5min. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:69) (`E-002/E39-014`)
- MonitorWindow exposes per-session cache hit rate with a target above seventy percent. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:69) (`E-002/E39-015`)
- RuntimeAdapter gains DeepSeekV4Flash, CerebrasFree, and GroqFree only after official endpoint/model/date verification; router uses them for tight-budget cases. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:71) (`E-002/E39-016`)
- Free-tier usage is counted per backend in UTC days, warns at eighty percent, refuses at or beyond ninety-five percent, and emits Approaching/Exceeded evidence. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:73) (`E-002/E39-017`)
- Pre-call estimates become p50/p95 bands and are stored beside actual cost; an actual-to-estimate ratio above 2.0 or below 0.5 emits CostEstimateInaccurate. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:75) (`E-002/E39-018`)
- Default layered caps are a $50/day soft alert, $100/day hard cutoff, and $1000/month typed-confirmation manual override; elai cloud override-cap emits session, amount, and confirmation string. (E-39_cost_token_economics.md:77) (`E-002/E39-019`)

#### Surfaces for E-40 (Symbol Graph Tools)
- E-40 is a three-session, 10-14-hour additive plan over planned B-29/B-29.5/B-30/C-24: SCIP import, scope graphs, property queries, dataflow, precision-only LSP, deterministic claim filtering/RAG/PageRank, and citation repair; no completion marker is present. - Existing planned 27 name shards, 256 reverse-call shards, 500-file LRU, depth-clamped hop-banded BFS, and four hardcoded tools remain; SCIP is Rust source-of-truth, tree-sitter fallback/non-Rust, and dataflow is an optional second pass. (`E-40:10,24,28,36`) (`E-006/E006-E40-002`)
- New `scip-import` modules parse a rust-analyzer `.scip` protobuf, map standardized SCIP symbol strings/Documents to the existing 27-shard layout, and expose `ScipImporter` plus `import_to_shards(...) -> ImportReport`. (`E-40:66,89-91,141-147,192,220-224`) (`E-006/E006-E40-003`)
- `elai index --scip <path>` is the CLI; the crates.io `scip` name/version/date/owner must be verified and recorded before dependency addition, and no homegrown symbol-string scheme is allowed. (`E-40:66,100,116,118,124,173-187,202,204,276`) (`E-006/E006-E40-004`)
- `ScopeGraph` reimplements Stack-Graph push/pop semantics over tree-sitter using file-local partial paths, cross-file stack joins, and `.elai_cc/scope_graph_rules/{language}.toml`; the archived stack-graphs crate is design-only and forbidden as a runtime dependency. (`E-40:68,92-93,125,149-153,193... (`E-006/E006-E40-005`)
- The unified model targets 13+ adapters but ships four starter TOMLs - Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go; underserved languages use heuristic tree-sitter edges with `confidence:Heuristic`, and nine further adapters are follow-up. (`E-40:68,193,239-242,279,283`) (`E-006/E006-E40-006`)
- `DslQuery` accepts Angle/Cypher-lite `MATCH/WHERE/RETURN`, compiles to shard lookups over 27+256 shards, and uses hop-banded BFS; example queries can combine callers, names, files, and touched traits. (`E-40:70,94-95,155-157,194`) (`E-006/E006-E40-007`)
- `elai symbol query '<dsl>'` and ToolDefinition `symbol_dsl_query` expose the DSL alongside C-24’s existing four BFS tools. (`E-40:70,100-101,115,118,200`) (`E-006/E006-E40-008`)
- `compute_impact_radius_dataflow(cache,target,depth)` is separate from call-edge impact; Rust uses SCIP def/ref occurrences and non-Rust uses language-specific tree-sitter def-use heuristics. (`E-40:72,96,105,159-161,195,227`) (`E-006/E006-E40-009`)
- Auditor PostToolUse dataflow defaults depth 2 and must remain within B-29.5 p99 ≤500 ms. (`E-40:72,195,211`) (`E-006/E006-E40-010`)
- `lsp_oracle::resolve_unresolved` runs only when graph output has `confidence:Unresolved` and affects an audit verdict; it spawns rust-analyzer/Pyright/tsserver as `lsp_oracle` through PerRoleRuntime and caches positions in the 500-file LRU. (`E-40:74,97,114,126-127,163-167,196`) (`E-006/E006-E40-011`)

- E-51 is a 2-3-session, 10-12-hour planned extension of shipped B-37/E-2/E-26: executable MLX and llama.cpp adapters, platform/artifact/UI/probe support, two spec-only future bridges, and hard-deferred NPU code; no completion marker is present. (`E-51:1-6,262-264`) (`E-006/E006-E51-001`)
- `RuntimeBackend::{Mlx,LlamaCpp}` extends the enum; `MlxAdapter` spawns vllm-mlx on Darwin arm64 and forwards `/v1/messages`, while `LlamaCppAdapter` spawns llama-server and either uses verified `/v1/messages` or a thin same-module response shim. (`E-51:43,70-73,78-81,178-180`) (`E-006/E006-E51-002`)
- Both adapters return descriptive `RuntimeAdapterError::Other`, never production unwrap, reuse permission opt-in/lifecycle helpers, and emit spawn/killed events on normal lifecycle or failure. (`E-51:43,76,82,92-93,178-181`) (`E-006/E006-E51-003`)
- `detect_mlx_capable()` returns `NotApple|AppleIntel|AppleSilicon{chip_family:M1..M5,gpu_cores}`; `detect_llamacpp_ep()` session-caches best `Vulkan|Cuda|Metal|Hip|Cpu` by parsing `--list-devices`. (`E-51:45,74-75,127-129,180,200`) (`E-006/E006-E51-004`)
- MLX refuses NotApple/AppleIntel rather than silently using CPU, and llama.cpp surfaces list-device parse failure; recoverable adapter errors return control to existing RuntimeOrchestrator fallback. (`E-51:45,84,94-96,106,180,195-197,257`) (`E-006/E006-E51-005`)

#### Surfaces for E-52 (LSP Integration)
- E-52 makes LSP an opt-in precision verifier, never the default retriever: one-shot diagnostics gate edits, headless SCIP refresh updates elai.map, and on-demand multilspy resolves overloaded/type-sensitive questions without an always-on language fleet. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:1-3`) (`E-005/E005-E52-001`)
- It depends on planned B-19 PostToolUse and B-29 symbol graph, coordinates with E-40's elai.map consumer, and is parallel-safe/complementary with E-51/E-53/E-54/E-55. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:4-6,12-21`) (`E-005/E005-E52-002`)
- LSP is justified for diagnostics/types while lexical+RAG remains retrieval; resident rust-analyzer/pyright/jdtls/clangd memory would exceed the sidecar envelope, and SCIP is preferred over LSIF. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:8-10`) (`E-005/E005-E52-003`)
- `DiagnosticProbe` dispatches `.rs` to `rust-analyzer diagnostics --output-format=json`, `.py` to `pyright --outputjson`, `.ts/.tsx` to `tsc --noEmit --pretty false`, and `.svelte` to machine-output `svelte-check`. (`E-52_lsp_integration.md:45,68-71,125-127,192`) (`E-005/E005-E52-004`)

#### Surfaces for E-53 (Formal Verification Codegen)
- The objective uses formal methods only where latency/assurance justify them: Critical-path Z3 in D-3 consensus, Kani in AUDITING, Verus in PR CI, Dafny IR for Critical Python, and no routine Lean proof loop. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:1-3) (`E-002/E53-001`)
- D-3 and C-52 are planned prerequisites, CSQ is claimed shipped, and E-51/E-52/E-54/E-55 are parallel-safe; E-53 additively extends D-3 and promotes a narrow subset of C-52. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:4-6,12-20) (`E-002/E53-002`)
- The justification distinguishes fast SMT/bounded/deductive checks from expensive theorem proving and emphasizes that compute-based verification resists plausible-but-wrong reasoning missed by PRMs/static analyzers. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:8-10) (`E-002/E53-003`)
- The DAFNYCOMP guard requires the specification to come from CSQ counterfactual, D-13 Adversary, or a human - not the model that authored the implementation. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:10,18) (`E-002/E53-004`)
- Z3SmtCheck extends D-3 VerificationResult as a VerifierKind and supplies one of the at-least-two consensus votes without changing existing verifier surfaces. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:14) (`E-002/E53-005`)
- C-52’s research spike remains reference material while Dafny SpecValidator becomes a narrow production path for auth/money/parser Python. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:15) (`E-002/E53-006`)
- Formal checks are gated by CSQ Critical classification to avoid overhead on ordinary edits; the named Critical classes are auth, money, crypto, parser, and untrusted input, with some task-specific subsets narrower. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:16,48-56) (`E-002/E53-007`)
- Z3, kani-verifier, Verus, Dafny, and Lean Copilot are all new dependencies and require identity/license/recency/pinned-release verification. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:20,93-97,117) (`E-002/E53-008`)
- Z3 encodes a Rust signature plus independent counterfactual postcondition to SMT-LIB2, times out after five seconds, maps Sat to BLOCK with counterexample, Unsat to a positive vote, and Unknown/Timeout to abstention. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:48-50) (`E-002/E53-009`)
- If an existing CSQ Critical enum cannot be found, CounterfactualClass Critical/NonCritical is added; D-3 file presence is likewise discovered before extension. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:50,255-256) (`E-002/E53-010`)
- Every Z3 specification carries origin and same-model origin is refused before solver execution. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:50) (`E-002/E53-011`)
- Kani outcomes are Verified, Falsified(counterexample), Timeout, and NotApplicable; falsification blocks and feeds the fixer, timeout only warns, and verified/falsified/timeout actions are emitted. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:52) (`E-002/E53-013`)
- Kani properties may come from CSQ, Adversary, or a human proof file; the AWS canonical install is version-pinned and identity-checked. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:52) (`E-002/E53-014`)
- verus_invariants encodes no-skipped FSM transitions, IPC v2 payload/header length bounds, and total KV-slot bytes not exceeding KV_CACHE_BUDGET_BYTES. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:54) (`E-002/E53-015`)
- verus-check runs in a dedicated PR job with a five-minute cap and gates COMMITTING rather than per-audit execution; violations or persistent timeout fail CI. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:54,115,299) (`E-002/E53-016`)
- Critical Python flow is independent spec, parallel implementation, thirty-second Dafny verification, then semantic SpecValidator comparison; outcomes are Verified, NotVerified, Timeout, or SpecMismatch and failure rows are emitted. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:56) (`E-002/E53-017`)
- The Sonnet SpecValidator agent receives function plus Critical classification, selects Z3/Kani/Verus/Dafny by language/property shape, consumes the independent postcondition, runs the tool, and returns only verdict plus grounding from its own context. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:58) (`E-002/E53-018`)
- SpecValidator never authors both spec and proof. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:58) (`E-002/E53-019`)
- LeanPremiseHint is optional, read-only, asynchronous, runs only after another formal BLOCK, never votes or applies changes, has a sixty-second background budget, and must not delay the BLOCK. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:60) (`E-002/E53-020`)
- A nightly PRMBench canary contains twenty human-validated deceptive diffs; with Z3/Kani enabled, every diff must yield at least one finding and longitudinal results are written to E-53-prmbench-results.md. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:62) (`E-002/E53-021`)
- SpecOrigin has CsqCounterfactual, Adversary, Human, and SameLlmAsImpl; the last is refused with spec_origin_violation_blocked. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:64) (`E-002/E53-022`)
- Contracts require no Lean VerifierKind/default/consensus path and zero formal-tool invocation for NonCritical work. (E-53_formal_verification_codegen.md:64) (`E-002/E53-023`)

#### Surfaces for E-54 (Eval Corpus Design)
- Effort is three sessions; D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24 are planned surfaces that E-54 replaces or augments, D-28/D-30 are deferred, and E-9/E-49/E-55 require dataset/metric/gate coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-002`)
- D-6 retains time-window framing but replaces its contamination/storage/schema implementation; D-7 gains KOR checks, D-23 matched/perturbed pairs, and D-24 semantic/test/performance-delta hooks. (`E-003/E003-E54-003`)
- Daily family/date shards cap at 500 tasks per directory; the first task in a shard emits corpus_shard_created. (`E-003/E003-E54-015`)
- problem and reference_solution are mandatory prompt/answer fields. (`E-003/E003-E54-018`)
- Passing pairs can emit kor_orthogonality_passed; the ten-pair matrix is cached in held-out/_audit/kor_matrix_{date}.json with daily refresh and bounded GPU work. (`E-003/E003-E54-030`)
- E-54 ships the matched-pair schema/harness; D-23 remains responsible for the full benchmark suite. (`E-003/E003-E54-035`)
- If ConStat’s reference formula cannot be verified/practically computed, a two-sigma sudden-jump detector is the explicit fallback. (`E-003/E003-E54-040`)
- Dynamic tasks are one-shot and not persisted, but query hash, timestamp, and MCQs are logged to held-out/_audit/knowledge-qa-{date}.jsonl. (`E-003/E003-E54-042`)
- Prod-derived audit data retains content hash and timestamp only, no PII, and is purgeable through elai eval-corpus purge-prod. (`E-003/E003-E54-046`)
- SycophancyMatchedPairPanel displays eval/deploy gaps and sandbagging flags. (`E-003/E003-E54-048`)
- Tauri commands are get_eval_corpus_status, get_sycophancy_matched_pair_results, and get_kor_orthogonality_status. (`E-003/E003-E54-049`)
- migrate_held_out idempotently converts flat tasks to shards/indexes and reruns 13-gram, cosine, and triplet validation. (`E-003/E003-E54-050`)
- Produced API includes ingest_task, canonical Task/family/test/provenance/pair types, shard/index operations, test execution, cross-family transfer, matched pairs, generator verification, perf detection, daily QA, and optional traffic injection. (`E-003/E003-E54-053`)
- The crate consumes planned D-6/D-7/D-23/D-24, embeddings/sidecar, blake3, chrono/serde/toml, and is reached from auditor, held-out ingest, shard/index/quarantine/audit paths. (`E-003/E003-E54-055`)
- Hard guards ban production unwrap/unregistered stubs, 9-gram-only filtering, disableable cosine, missing tests/cutoffs/pairs, weak reference tests, failed KOR, flat storage, default-on production probes, unaudited dynamic generation, non-blake3 hashes, and single-generator synthesis. (`E-003/E003-E54-056`)
- The canonical smoke is a semantic paraphrase that passes 13-gram but scores about .92 cosine and is rejected without index growth; quarantine records both IDs/match details. (`E-003/E003-E54-057`)
- Deterministic checks verify filters, absence of 9-gram fallback, shards/index/schema/families, dual test execution, KOR, matched pairs, rotation, perf detector, dynamic audit, default-off traffic, blake3/no-unwrap, and ten smoke/contract passes. (`E-003/E003-E54-058`)
- Acceptance requires all data, filters, orthogonality, pair/perturbation, rotation, detection, dynamic/prod tiers, fourteen events, two panels/three commands, idempotent migration, blake3/no-unwrap, and green additive workspace integration. (`E-003/E003-E54-059`)
- Nineteen tests/contracts cover exact/paraphrase rejection, required schema, strong tests, KOR, 15pp gap, generator failures, 30pp jump, SearXNG audit, opt-in, shards, minimum n, mandatory cosine/tests, no flat layout, deploy wording, and D-23 pairs. (`E-003/E003-E54-060`)
- BGE/Nomic dependency addition needs explicit confirmation; cosine code is proposed behind a default-ON Cargo feature. (`E-003/E003-E54-063`)
- D-23/D-24 promote after consuming this crate; later patches tune thresholds/NTFS/false positives, decide ConStat, measure generator diversity, and expand dynamic QA. (`E-003/E003-E54-065`)
- cosine_filter_never_disabled is a contract, yet the dependency is feature-gated and can be removed with --no-default-features; whether such a build is allowed in production is unresolved. (`E-003/E003-E54-067`)
- New modules ban todo/unimplemented, yet missing sandbox explicitly permits a registered TODO stub; the exception is tracked but still contradicts a literal source scan unless the contract exempts registry-backed markers. (`E-003/E003-E54-068`)
- The source calls the work a replacement/canonical implementation for planned D surfaces but later calls integration additive and those surfaces unaffected; ownership of future D-6 edits needs coordination. (`E-003/E003-E54-069`)
- E-18, E-26, E-27, and E-32 all edit python/elai_inference/server.py. E-26 explicitly sequences its XGrammar slice after unresolved E-2; E-27 requires coordinated edit windows; E-32 places FITM after the existing processor chain. These are shared-file ordering constraints, not independent edits. (`E-003/INT-E003-001`)
- E-18 treats XGrammar tool-envelope/schema masking as a main deliverable, while E-26 separately defines an XGrammarLogitsProcessor as gated RECON_NEEDED. Implementers must unify or clearly separate the two processor responsibilities to avoid duplicate compilers/caches. (`E-003/INT-E003-002`)
- Processor order is constrained across plans: E-26 XGrammar masks at the HEAD before DoLa/ETC; E-32 FITM calibrates AFTER DoLa/ETC/steering; E-27 changes weight/cache loading and must not disturb either order. (`E-003/INT-E003-003`)
- E-26/E-27/E-32 form a runtime ladder: SGLang is an optional role-routed backend, AWQ/FP8 is an initially default-off Sidecar format/cache lane, and 32K/FITM/deep mode changes effective context and escalation policy. (`E-003/INT-E003-004`)
- E-18 one-shot recovery and E-44 idempotency/SAGA must compose: a retry reuses a stable idempotency key, observes cached irreversible results, and may not double-execute compensation or side effects. (`E-003/INT-E003-005`)
- E-4 completion evidence can consume E-44 durable action/audit rows and E-12 production-check findings; E-4’s evidence wrapper is the user-visible trust surface for those lower-level records. (`E-003/INT-E003-006`)
- E-4 structural sycophancy defense is measured by E-9’s four-behavior probes and E-54’s matched eval/deploy and perturbed-pair corpus schema; the three plans respectively implement defense, public/internal scoring, and eval-awareness hardening. (`E-003/INT-E003-007`)
- All nine sources expand SSB evidence. E-44’s schema/migrator and append-only constraints therefore underpin E-4/E-9/E-12/E-18/E-26/E-27/E-32/E-54 action-type additions. (`E-003/INT-E003-010`)
- Default-OFF/opt-in controls recur: E-26 SGLang needs endpoint plus wire-dark allowlist, E-27 AWQ/FP8 awaits three evidence runs, E-32 FITM awaits +5pp and deep mode needs 24GB, and E-54 production traffic needs explicit consent. (`E-003/INT-E003-011`)
- Add normalization/K=4 algorithm, mandatory non-disableable semantic pass, complete shard/index schema, five families, canonical task/test/provenance/pair/hash schema, dual test execution, KOR LoRA matrix, sandbag telemetry, generator rotation/full rescans, ConStat fallback, daily ephemeral QA, co... (`E-003/DELTA-E003-E54-01`)
- Detect/verbalize evaluation awareness. (`SUMMARY/E-54.F07`)
- Refactor .elai_cc/held-out/. (`SUMMARY/E-54.F09`)
- Add scripts/eval_corpus_audit.py. (`SUMMARY/E-54.F10`)

#### Surfaces for E-55 (Agentic RL and Reward)
- **PLANNED, 3 sessions/10-12h for non-weight rungs.** Extends planned D-2/D-3/D-5/D-13/D-23 and keeps D-28 deferred. Actual SFT is follow-up; weight-level DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO is hard-deferred. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-001`)
- D-5 receives fused observations/new arms; D-2 supplies PRM; D-3/E-53 supply ORM verifier consensus; D-13/B-37 supply cloud route; D-23/E-54 supply sycophancy; E-8 may own GEPA; no existing RLAIF/GEPA/MONA/SFT pipeline is assumed. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-003`)
- `RlaifJudge::rate_trajectory` uses `PerRoleRuntime::cloud_sonnet`, samples 1/10 via reservoir, rates five Likert dimensions plus rationale/latency, and calibrates quarterly against 20 human-graded tasks. Correlation <.6 downgrades it to advisory. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-004`)
- GEPA takes bottom quartile from K=100 PPM-scored rollouts, asks Sonnet for refinements, retains mean-reward×semantic-diversity Pareto arms, and evicts only when the arm’s 95th-percentile reward stays below leader median after ≥30 trials. Emits evolved/evicted. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-005`)
- `CompositeReward=base-format-length-sycophancy-repetition`: .1/format violation; .05 if length >2× or <.3× median; .2 matched-pair sycophancy; .05 repeated consecutive 50-token sequence. Myopic >.8 plus RLAIF step-validity <.5 emits `RewardHackingSuspected`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-007`)
- `RolloutCollector` writes only GREEN (PASS, sycophancy-clean, no hacking flag) JSONL with prompt/trajectory/PRM/ORM/RLAIF/reward/diff/verdict. At 200 it emits `SftTrainingThresholdReached` and opens a ticket; no fine-tune occurs in E-55. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-008`)
- Nightly canary uses 20 human-verified high-reward/low-quality cases and must flag ≥16/20; not a per-audit gate. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-009`)
- D-5 Beta observation defaults to binary `composite_reward>.5`; optional Jeffreys/fractional update. New GEPA arms start Beta(1,1); every update emits `BaiArmObservationRecorded`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-010`)
- `UnlockStatus` requires all three: ≥3 stable-arm/no-tripwire but below-target sessions; ORM coverage ≥80%; and 2×3090 or rented 24GB headroom. Only then emit `RlWeightUpdateUnlocked`+ticket; until then DPO/PPO/GRPO/KTO are blocked. Registered conditional stub is `E-55.B7`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-011`)
- Contract rejects files/modules matching DPO/PPO/GRPO/DAPO/KTO until a recorded unlock; DPO remains specially prohibited due to data shape/OOD evidence. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-012`)
- Four live panels expose fusion, judge/calibration, GEPA Pareto frontier and the three deferred-RL conditions; four matching Tauri commands query them. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-013`)
- Wiring exports judge/evolver/fusion/composite/collector/unlock APIs, nine event names and four commands; consumes planned D surfaces, PerRoleRuntime, E-54 embeddings, E-53 verifier, blake3/serde; persists dated JSONL/index and stub registry. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-015`)
- Negative contract: no unwrap/todo; no weight-update modules; ≥200 collection gate; 1/10 judge cap; <.6 advisory downgrade; GEPA diversity and ≥30 trials; default .4/.6; mandatory MONA; ≥80% canary; blake3; no direct Anthropic SDK. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-016`)
- Deterministic checks cover five rating fields/sample cap, GEPA+30 trials, four ORM variants/.4-.6, four penalties/MONA, 200 threshold, three unlock fields, absent RL modules/direct SDK, blake3/no unwrap, stub entry, four panels and eight cargo smoke tests. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-018`)
- Done gates require the routing/calibration/evolution/fusion/collector/posterior/unlock/canary/UI contracts, no RL modules, blake3/no unwrap, green workspace and verified citations while keeping all planned/deferred dependencies additive. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-019`)
- Sixteen enumerated tests cover route/sample/calibration, three GEPA properties, two fusion properties, two MONA properties, two collector properties, unlock, BAI update and three contracts (module absence/canary/no direct SDK). (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-020`)
- File lifecycle creates six orchestrator modules, 17 stated test files, four panels, decision/training docs; modifies planned D surfaces, auditor, Tauri and session stub ledger. Missing D-5 may receive only a minimal integration stub. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-021`)
- Open Q5: no known BAI saturation curve; log arm stability/saturation per session to `E-55-bai-convergence-trace.jsonl`. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-026`)
- Operational risks: default 100 judge calls/session then `RlaifQuotaExceeded`; quarantine GEPA arms flagged by MONA; allow per-task-family fusion overrides; E-55.1 needs new deps, 2×3090 and user confirmation. (`E-001/DEEP-E001-E55-027`)

### User-facing surfaces (J)

Every window, panel, drawer, command, CLI verb, flag, status display, or notification named in the aggregate surface index or SURFACE-tagged atoms. One line each with atom ID.

### User-facing surfaces (K)

Every window, panel, drawer, command, CLI verb, flag, status display, or notification named by a SURFACE-tagged atom. One line each with atom ID. Deduplicated by atom ID.

#### Surfaces — K-0
- `K-001/K0-E007`: `[E/CAP]` K-T2 WEDGE + DISTRIBUTION (A-4, K-3, A-5): A-4 is portable `.rra`/`elai wrap`; K-3 renders evidence into GitHub check-runs + PR comments; A-5 is review-time study. Delta: KD-2. _(anchor: K-0:L76-L82)_
- `K-001/K0-E009`: `[E/CAP]` K-T4 BUYER-SIDE EVIDENCE (K-6, K-7): K-6 builds `elai export compliance`; K-7 is AppSec/insurance positioning brief (pure prose). No org/SSO build. _(anchor: K-0:L92-L96)_
- `K-001/K0-E011`: `[E/CAP]` K-T6 SEQUENCING / CUT (K-10 doctrine in index): priority order, no-new-letters, activation-over-authoring, canvas demotion, kill-switches. Delta: KD-5. _(anchor: K-0:L106-L110)_

### User-facing surfaces (O)

Windows, panels, drawers, commands, CLI verbs, flags, status displays, notifications, published commercial/docs surfaces, and other SURFACE-tagged atoms. One line per atom with ID.

#### Surfaces for O-0 (O-Plan Index / track-wide contract)
- O is a product-surface letter that ships a new user-facing feature, unlike N’s invent-nothing interlacing role. (`O-001/O0-E008`) [O0:L11-L13 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L45]
- The new surface is the combination of a research daemon, typed scheduler, mounted brain vault, and canvas workflow mode. (`O-001/O0-E009`) [O0:L12-L13 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L46]
- Named composed subsystems are `B-42` Cosmos, `C-9` task_runner, `3F` rules-engine, `E-5` memory, `D-5` privacy, `G-1` taint, `F-3` tool-filter, `G-2` VCR, and `H-12/J-31/J-60` canvas. (`O-001/O0-E011`) [O0:L13-L15 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L48]
- Genuinely new mechanisms are a closed `TaskSpec` vocabulary, vault namespace claims, canvas `WORKFLOW` mode, and Cosmos manifest generalization. (`O-001/O0-E012`) [O0:L15-L16 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L49]
- O-1 swaps Cosmos’s topic source for a user-editable typed topic set. (`O-001/O0-E021`) [O0:L33-L34 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L58]
- O-2 journals fires and supplies a dashboard intervention-card inbox. (`O-001/O0-E026`) [O0:L35-L36 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L63]
- O-3 mounts, rather than converts, a portable Markdown brain vault. (`O-001/O0-E028`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L65]
- O-3 adds a namespace-claims contract so ELAI and TEIKOKU can share one vault. (`O-001/O0-E029`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L66]
- `memory_facts` remains the machine-grain store while the vault becomes the user-grain surface. (`O-001/O0-E030`) [O0:L37-L38 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L67]
- O-4 adds canvas `WORKFLOW` as an editor and monitor over TaskSpecs. (`O-001/O0-E031`) [O0:L39-L40 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L68]
- O-4 dispatches through the `J-31` FSM and must never introduce a canvas runtime. (`O-001/O0-E033`) [O0:L39-L40 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L70]
- Execution requires re-reading the live baseline and adding a dashboard done-item. (`O-001/O0-E047`) [O0:L52 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L84]
- O-4 is effort `M`, Wave `3`, with lever `canvas-as-spec-editor`. (`O-001/O0-E068`) [O0:L76-L77 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L105]
- O-3 adds `vault_write` and `claim_violation`. (`O-001/O0-E072`) [O0:L82-L83 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L109]
- O-3 may instead ship with interim CLI caller `elai brain write`. (`O-001/O0-E079`) [O0:L93-L94 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L116]
- New dependencies require anti-slopsquatting review; none are expected. (`O-001/O0-E085`) [O0:L102 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L122]
- The vault is mounted and never converted into `memory_facts`. (`O-001/O0-E091`) [O0:L111 | ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L128]

#### Surfaces for O-registers (cross-unit IX / SD / AC / INF registers)
- A4 requires disjoint vault namespaces for the two masters. (`SUMMARY/O.X.E13`) [O-SUMMARY:L82 | ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L264]

- A successful digest is connected to a measured `For-You` click signal. (`SUMMARY/O.X.E16`) [O-SUMMARY:L83-L84 | ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L267]
- title=`Classify, deduplicate, and produce.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L579): The TEIKOKU-derived workflow is fetch → enum classification → duplicate precheck against a rejected ledger → file → layered digest →, at full scope, guarded living-page upsert (`O1:L10`). Tier 1 covers `steal-scan` and `monitor`; `leaderboard`, `discovery`, and living leaderboard pages wait for Tier 2/O-3 (`O1:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH03`)
- title=`Represent scheduled execution as data.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L580): O-2 persists strict TaskSpec rows in SQLite. Each row combines a closed trigger, ordered closed stages, and a closed sink (`O2:L9-L10,L27-L30,L49-L53`). Tier 1 brings Cron/Manual, `Fetch/Classify/Gate/Digest`, fire rows, and DashboardInbox; event triggering, orchestrator stage kinds, and missed-run hookup are deferred (`O2:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH04`)
- title=`Surface only useful scheduled output.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L582): Result-bearing output creates an existing intervention card. Nothing-to-report output auto-archives, leaving only the SSB receipt; the predicate is based on pipeline result count (`O2:L34-L36,L65-L68`). (`O-001/IX-PATH06`)
- title=`Write selected research to the owner vault.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L583): O-3’s production seam is O-2’s `FileToBrain` stage calling a guarded writer (or interim `elai brain write`) (`O3:L57-L70`). The writer resolves a configured vault root, validates ownership at a single chokepoint, creates/appends only in ELAI-owned space, and upserts only machine-owned rankings/queue/index pages (`O3:L18-L35`). It records `vault_write {namespace,page,mode}` or `claim_violation` (`O3:L65-L68`). (`O-001/IX-PATH07`)
- title=`Keep the two memory grains separate.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L584): The mounted deterministic Markdown vault is the human/owner grain; E-5 `memory_facts` remains the prompt-feeding machine grain. There is no conversion or dual-write, and ELAI adapts to existing vault bytes (`O3:L7,L10-L11,L37-L46,L53-L64`). Prompt-bound personal content is barred pending the Tier-2 D-5 read wiring (`O3:L18-L20,L80-L81`). (`O-001/IX-PATH08`)
- title=`Project, inspect, and eventually edit visually.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L585): O-4 lists TaskSpecs through Tauri and renders a node-per-stage graph in Svelte. Provenance-labelled edges, J-60 last-run chrome, and missing-consumer disconnection make execution receipts and wire-dark state visible (`O4:L19-L33,L49-L71`). Tier 1 is read-only; Tier 2 writes node edits back to TaskSpec rows and adds provenance drill-down (`O4:L19-L21`). (`O-001/IX-PATH09`)
- title=`Run-now shares the same backend.` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L586): The canvas calls O-2’s dispatcher, which emits the same `task_spec_fired` receipt through the normal FSM. No client-side scheduler, stage runner, spec store, or separate execution event is allowed (`O4:L34-L39,L46-L47,L68-L73`). (`O-001/IX-PATH10`)
- surface=`Research topics` state=`User-editable manifest `[[research.topics]]`` lifecycle=`Existing hourly Cosmos loop enumerates topics; existing Cosmos artifacts can time-decay to `DECAYED`; drawer shows kind and last-run trust tier` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L605) (`O-001/IX-DATA001`)
- surface=``task_spec_fired`` state=`O-2 schema-version bump site` lifecycle=`Carries `{spec_id, trigger_cause, stage_path}` exactly once per due tick; reused by O-4 run-now` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L610) (`O-001/IX-DATA006`)
- surface=`Inbox intervention card` state=`Existing dashboard surface` lifecycle=`Created only for result-bearing runs; empty runs auto-archive and retain SSB only` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L611) (`O-001/IX-DATA007`)
- surface=`Markdown vault` state=`Configured mounted root` lifecycle=`Pure read/byte-identical round trip; claimed create/append; machine-owned upsert; external-editor ownership` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L612) (`O-001/IX-DATA008`)
- surface=``vault_write`` state=`O-3 schema-version bump site` lifecycle=`Records namespace, page, and create/append/upsert mode` (ledger-line: DEEP-O-001.discovery.md:L614) (`O-001/IX-DATA010`)

#### Surfaces for O-summary-wide (summary-wide premise, cross-cutting digest, workflows, invariants, silent candidates)
- The desired product is a “TEIKOKU-style personal research machine on the ELAI canvas.” (`SUMMARY/O.G.E02`) [O-SUMMARY:L9-L10 | ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L53]
- title=`Scheduled execution path (`O-2`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L279): Supervisor-plane `Cron`, `SsbEvent`, or `Manual` trigger -> persisted typed `TaskSpec` -> ordered closed-enum stages -> one journaled `task_spec_fired` row with cause and stage path -> one of the typed sinks -> intervention-card inbox only when the fire bears a result. Temporal monitoring detects missed runs; a Cron due now fires exactly once per tick. Source: O-SUMMARY:L35-L46. (`SUMMARY/WF-02`)
- title=`Guarded vault path (`O-3`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L283): O-1/O-2 `FileToBrain` request -> namespace-claims parser -> hard write-scope check -> guarded vault writer/upsert -> deterministic markdown page and `vault_write` row. A denied attempt emits `claim_violation` without producing the forbidden write. Prompt-bound reads remain separated from E-5 machine memory, and personal topics may not enter project/cloud prompts. Source: O-SUMMARY:L51-L62. (`SUMMARY/WF-03`)
- title=`Visual editing and run path (`O-4`)` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L287): Select WORKFLOW -> list/project O-2 TaskSpecs to typed nodes and provenance-bearing edges -> overlay last-run SSB state -> edit a node by editing its closed-enum-constrained spec row -> display missing consumers as disconnected -> `run-now` dispatches through the normal FSM -> O-2 emits the fire row. The canvas may never execute directly. Source: O-SUMMARY:L67-L77. (`SUMMARY/WF-04`)
- title=`Track validation loop` (ledger-line: 15-O-SUMMARY_INDEX.discovery.md:L291): Digest success -> measure digest opens and `For-You` clicks -> after `N` days of zero engagement, decay the topic instead of preserving an unused default-off feature. Source: O-SUMMARY:L83-L84. (`SUMMARY/WF-05`)
